jobs.title: TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

  

Position Type: Temporary, Full-Time (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt  
Employment Period: January–June 2027  
Reports To: Schools Program Manager  
Location: In-person at SFUSD school sites and LYRIC’s Purple House, San Francisco  
Hourly Rate: $30.58/hour (non-negotiable per LYRIC’s equity-based pay model)  
Union Status: Union position (OPEIU Local 29)

ABOUT THE POSITION

LYRIC seeks a thoughtful and experienced Temporary Schools Program Coordinator to deliver school-based support groups for SFUSD students, creating affirming spaces for LGBTQQ+ youth to strengthen positive identity development, self-esteem, personal growth, and peer connection. Serving 120 youth annually, the program offers weekly groups exploring healthy relationships, self-confidence, identity, and navigating school and community systems. Each cohort includes 3–10 students, averaging 5 participants, with sessions lasting up to 60 minutes, typically held in high school Wellness Centers or school-based health centers. The coordinator also connects students with LYRIC’s Purple House programs and supports programming there during spring break and summer break dates within the January–June employment period.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Youth Development & Engagement: Build on young people’s strengths, center their voices and choices, and support their leadership, independence, and progress toward their goals.

* Equity & Inclusion: Create affirming environments for LGBTQQ+ youth across identities and backgrounds. Practice cultural humility, examine personal biases, and recognize how systemic barriers affect young people’s lives.

* Relationship Building & Collaboration: Build trust with youth, coworkers, and community partners. Coordinate services, share relevant information appropriately, and contribute to shared goals.

* Effective Communication: Listen actively, communicate clearly and respectfully, and address concerns directly and constructively. Adapt communication to different needs and situations.

* Emotional Awareness & Self-Management: Recognize how personal emotions and reactions affect others. Remain grounded during challenging interactions and respond with empathy, professionalism, and a trauma-informed approach.

* Critical Thinking & Sound Judgment: Assess situations, identify appropriate next steps, and recognize when to seek guidance. Respond to safety concerns within established protocols and the scope of the role.

* Professional Integrity & Accountability: Maintain appropriate boundaries and confidentiality, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for actions. Communicate barriers early and follow organizational policies.

* Program Delivery & Organization: Prepare and deliver purposeful services and activities, manage time and resources responsibly, and complete accurate, timely documentation and follow-up.

* Learning & Adaptability: Seek and apply feedback, build relevant skills, and adjust to changing youth and program needs. Use reflection and experience to improve practice.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Youth Development & Group Facilitation

* Facilitate weekly support groups promoting positive identity development, self-esteem, healthy relationships, personal growth, and peer connection.
* Center youth voices and choices, creating opportunities for leadership and meaningful participation.
* Prepare and adapt age-appropriate curriculum informed by positive youth development, harm reduction, and youth sexual health education.
* Create inclusive, affirming environments that reflect students’ identities and address barriers to participation.
* Provide individual check-ins and basic resource support while maintaining boundaries and supporting youth independence.
* Respond to challenging group dynamics with empathy, self-awareness, and appropriate de-escalation; seek support when needed.

School-to-Community Connections

* Connect students with programs, services, and opportunities at LYRIC’s Purple House.
* Coordinate introductions, referrals, and follow-up with colleagues to help students access services and maintain engagement.
* Support Purple House programming during spring break and summer break dates within the employment period.

Program Planning & Partnerships

* Plan weekly sessions of up to 45 minutes for cohorts of 3–10 students.
* Prepare materials in advance, manage responsibilities across school sites, and use time and resources responsibly.
* Build collaborative relationships with school staff, counselors, Wellness Center staff, and community partners.
* Coordinate schedules, meeting spaces, and student referrals; communicate expectations and changes clearly.
* Participate in student support meetings when appropriate, sharing information within confidentiality requirements and the scope of the role.
* Use student feedback and participation data to improve programming and contribute to the program’s annual goal of serving 120 youth.

Documentation, Accountability & Safety

* Maintain accurate, timely records of participation, activities, referrals, and outcomes in LYRIC’s data systems.
* Contribute to program reports and funder documentation.
* Protect confidential information and follow procedures for storing and sharing records.
* Recognize safety concerns, follow reporting and response protocols, and consult the Schools Program Manager when guidance is needed.
* Follow through on commitments and communicate barriers early.

Teamwork & Professional Growth

* Participate in supervision, team meetings, trainings, and organization-wide events.
* Collaborate across departments and contribute to shared responsibilities.
* Seek and apply feedback, reflect on personal assumptions and reactions, and take responsibility for improvement.
* Adapt to changing school and program needs while communicating about priorities and capacity.
* Support an organized transition of program information and outstanding follow-up at the end of the assignment.

YOU BRING

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Shared Garden)
jobs.description:
**Shared Garden Coordinator**

*“Valley Verde is dedicated to building healthy and resilient communities by providing low-income families educational programs, edible gardens, and micro-entrepreneurship opportunities that create food security and lead to self sufficiency."*

**Location**: San Jose, Morgan Hill, and Gilroy, CA

**Program:** Shared Garden Program

**Job Type:** Full-time, 40 hours per week

**Benefits:** Paid vacation/sick days

**Job Description:**

Valley Verde is an urban agriculture nonprofit based in San Jose uses home gardening as a catalyst for improving the long-term health of underserved Santa Clara County residents. Valley Verde works with each participant for a year or more, providing a comprehensive set of culturally relevant services and resources to enable families to successfully grow their own organic produce gardens and prepare healthy meals with fresh vegetables. We are seeking a coordinator to expand our Shared Garden Program to reach low-income families. Knowledge of the local area and community organizations local to the area would be beneficial for this role.

Essential job functions: Assist with program organization, implementing Shared Garden Program and assist with tracking all program data.

Tasks include, but are not limited to:

* Travel throughout Santa Clara County to facilitate monthly organic gardening workshops for participants of the Shared Garden Program
* Translate curriculum and facilitate workshops in Spanish
* Communicate via email, phone calls, text messages, or in person, on a monthly basis with participants regarding workshops, attendance, and upcoming events
* Collect and enter data monthly for participant attendance, home visits, and check-ins
* Schedule and conduct monthly check-ins, and quarterly garden visits with participants
* Create and upload training videos to online learning platforms, as needed
* In collaboration with the Program Manager, review and update curriculum, lesson plans, and programming as needed
* Troubleshoot garden issues including diseases and pests using organic methods
* Organize and assist with the distribution of garden materials (heavy lifting, 30-40 lb bags)
* Assist with Planting Weeks and any other program events
* Represent Valley Verde and develop partnerships within the community
* Community outreach, recruit and enroll program participants, volunteers and interns through tabling events
* Assist customers with sales of seedlings at the site
* Assist with the Sow & Grow Community Days
* Create Social Media content for the Shared Garden Program
* Other duties as assigned by the Program Manager

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Must have regular/reliable access to a vehicle with appropriate insurance for transportation
* Must be detail oriented and accurately report program attendance and other participant statistics
* Experience working in a multiethnic community environment
* Ability to develop professional relationships with program participants regardless of language barriers, cultural differences, or physical/mental abilities
* Ability to lift 30-40 lbs for bed, soil and compost distribution
* Must be extremely organized and have the ability to prioritize projects to meet deadlines consistently
* Must be able to work independently and collaboratively in a team, show creativity, and ability to initiate and complete projects with limited supervision
* Bi-lingual English/Spanish or English/Vietnamese required
* At least 1 year of teaching or group facilitation preferred
* At least 1 year of experience growing organic vegetables and urban gardening preferred
* Strong verbal and written communication skills required
* Excellent computer skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Suite, Mailchimp, and Canva
* Must be able to sit, stand, walk, lift, bend, and twist to complete garden projects and activities
* Experience operating power tools, building, and assembling irrigation systems is a plus

**Education:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Community Development, or Education strongly preferred.
* Master Gardener’s certification is strongly preferred.
* Other related coursework or experience can be substituted.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $21.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

* Supports the development of marketing materials and other program content.
* Identifies opportunities for targeted outreach based on program growth priorities.
* Communicates membership pipeline information, conversion opportunities, and enrollment barriers to physicians and program leadership.

jobs.title: Community Health Advocate
jobs.description:
Asian Health Services, founded in 1974, provides medical, dental, and behavioral health services to more than 50,000 patients. Our approach to well-being focuses on “whole patient health” for all. We go beyond our clinic walls and invest in our community’s overall health. We know that income, housing, and environmental struggles lie at the heart of poor health. That’s why we also address food insecurity, youth leadership, and culturally competent care while working towards supporting safer streets and vibrant communities.

**Job Summary:**

As a key member of the Community Liaison Unit, the Community Health Advocate enhances access to and satisfaction with Asian Health Services by providing culturally and linguistically competent support to patients and community members. This role focuses on advocacy, community engagement, and outreach while representing the underserved Asian community's health rights and needs. The position involves planning and implementing advocacy activities, organizing health education events, and participating in public forums, policy discussions, and community partnerships.

### **Essential Job Functions**

* Conduct health education and outreach on topics like access to healthcare, mental health, and public policy.
* Attend and organize community events, workshops, and forums.
* Develop culturally appropriate health education materials and ensure their effective dissemination.
* Advocate for the rights and needs of the Asian community in public forums and policy discussions.
* Provide translation and interpretation services for healthcare interactions.
* Collect and analyze community data to support program development and evaluation.
* Serve as a back-up in patient services such as appointment scheduling, interpreting, and handling inquiries.
* Participate in agency-wide initiatives like fundraising and special events.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s degree and two years of experience in a health-related field, or a high school diploma and four years of relevant experience.
* Knowledge of health and social services in Asian immigrant communities is preferred.
* Ability to work inclusively with diverse individuals across various socio-economic backgrounds.
* Strong problem-solving, leadership, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in English and one of the following languages: Cantonese, Mandarin, and/or Vietnamese

  

**Benefits That Support You**  
We're committed to supporting our team's well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

**Health & Wellness**

* 100% employer-paid medical, dental & vision coverage
* Acupuncture & chiropractic coverage

**Time Off**

* 12 vacation days
* 12 sick days
* 12 paid holidays + 3 floating holidays (additional flexible days you can use anytime)

**Financial & Retirement**

* 403(b) with 3% employer contribution + up to 2% match
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) & Dependent Care Assistance

**Additional Support**

* Commuter benefits
* Long-Term Disability Insurance

**Please note:** We are not seeking support from staffing agencies at this time. Direct applicants only.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Overnight Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of interim housing and services for homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With over two dozen interim supportive housing communities and more on the way, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

The Overnight Operations Coordinator provides mobile operational leadership, training, coaching, scheduling support, and crisis response across LifeMoves Interim Supportive Housing programs in Santa Clara and San Mateo Counties. Serving as the first line of operational leadership overnight, Coordinators partner with Residential Service Coordinators, Resident Managers, Program Aides, Shift Leads, Program Directors, and the Overnight Program Director to ensure safe, consistent, trauma-informed services across sites.

The Overnight Operations Coordinator reports to the Overnight Program Director and is one of two Coordinators who, together with the director, form a three-person overnight leadership team. This position has no direct reports; site leadership retains overall site responsibility and direct staff supervision. Success in this role is reflected in confident frontline staff, effective crisis response, reliable overnight coverage, consistent operations, and stronger collaboration across sites.

This position works 12:00 AM to 8:30 AM on a weekly schedule staggered with the second Coordinator to provide seven-day coverage. The Overnight Program Director sets the primary county assignment and cross-county coverage based on operational needs.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Scope of Authority***

* Provides overnight functional leadership through site visits, training, coaching, staff meetings, scheduling support, and emergency response. May direct and prioritize tasks during the shift, delegate immediate tasks while working alongside staff, approve overnight scheduling details in Paycom within approved overtime guidelines, coordinate authorized temporary reassignment between nearby sites, and direct crisis response.
* Program Directors retain overall site responsibility. Operations and Service Managers, where assigned, or other designated site supervisors directly supervise Residential Service Coordinators, including overnight staff. Formal supervision, evaluations, discipline, hiring, time-off approval, and time and attendance approval remain with site leadership and authorized agency personnel.
* Documents performance concerns and observations, provides immediate coaching and direction, and refers concerns to the employee's supervisor. Coordinates follow-up with site leadership and escalates significant or unresolved concerns to the Overnight Program Director or designated on-call leader.

***Mobile Operational Leadership & Staffing Support***

* Conduct planned and responsive site visits; serve as an accessible operational resource for overnight staff and assess cross-site operational needs.
* Identify systemic and site-specific concerns and act within delegated authority, or escalate to the Overnight Program Director.
* Coordinate authorized temporary staff reassignment between nearby sites to address shortages, considering staff qualifications and required coverage at both sites.
* Provide temporary on-site leadership and hands-on assistance at short-staffed sites when necessary; communicate prolonged coverage needs to leadership without losing sight of cross-site responsibilities.
* Assist with admissions, client transitions, and other operational priorities during periods of increased demand, following approved procedures.
* Collaborate with site supervisors to review overnight task expectations and protect time for safety rounds, monitoring, and crisis readiness. Report recurring staffing gaps, fatigue concerns, and operational barriers.

***Overnight Scheduling & Coverage Support***

* Support overnight scheduling and coverage planning using agency-approved tools such as Paycom, within authorized system access.
* Review overnight schedules and attendance in Paycom to identify coverage gaps, call-outs, and upcoming shortages across sites.
* Approve overnight scheduling details in Paycom, such as shift swaps, coverage assignments, and schedule adjustments, in consultation with site supervisors and in line with agency policy. Approvals must stay within approved overtime guidelines; changes that would result in overtime require prior approval from site leadership or authorized agency personnel. Ensure required staffing levels and qualifications are met at each site.
* Coordinate shift coverage and authorized temporary reassignments between nearby sites, and communicate schedule changes promptly to site leadership, the Overnight Program Director, and affected staff.
* Help staff use scheduling and timekeeping tools correctly.
* Report recurring scheduling patterns, such as frequent call-outs or chronic understaffing at a site, to support proactive staffing decisions.

***Training, Coaching & Recognition***

* Plan and deliver competency-based training in nonviolent conflict resolution, de-escalation, trauma-informed practice, harm reduction, and overnight procedures. Deliver CPR training when qualified and authorized, or arrange qualified instructors.
* Provide day-to-day coaching to Residential Service Coordinators, Resident Managers, Program Aides, and Shift Leads, reinforcing agency expectations through observation, feedback, and hands-on support. Favor coaching over correction whenever possible.
* Support onboarding and mentoring of new overnight employees through demonstrations, scenarios, observation, and constructive feedback. Use quieter periods for learning only when safety and coverage permit.

jobs.description:
Your Role:

This position supports the implementation of the quality systems in compliance with cGMPs and other company policies.

* Perform review of batch records for final product, cell banks including in-process testing, QC release testing data packages, labeling, packaging, and all supporting documentation.
* Inspect, review, and disposition raw materials, reagents and components.
* Facilitate investigations relating to manufactured products and raw materials.
* Provide QA oversight during GMP manufacturing operations.
* Conduct line clearances, in-process inspections, support final product packaging operations, etc.
* Support the implementation of the Change Control, Deviation Reporting and CAPA programs.
* Review and revise standard operating procedures, study protocols and reports, etc.
* Coordinate release final cell-based therapeutic products for clinical applications.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Must have ability to handle more than one task at a time and must work at a rapid pace while maintaining attention to detail.

Work Environment:

This job is performed in a temperature-controlled facility without exposure to extreme hot or cold temperatures. Generally, this job is performed in a cleanroom setting and routinely uses standard medical and research equipment such as centrifuges, biosafety cabinets, microscopes, incubators, chromatography devices and columns, tangential-flow filtration devices and filters, peristaltic pumps and metering fill pumps, pipettes and computers. jobs.title: Finance and Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE LYCÉE FRANÇAIS DE SAN FRANCISCO**

The Lycée Français de San Francisco (the Lycée) is a French immersion and International College Preparatory school with 820+ students across three Bay Area campuses. The Lycée strives to maintain an international community for teachers, parents, and students of diverse social and cultural backgrounds while providing a rich educational environment that emphasizes academic excellence and personal achievement.

Our program is based on the highly recognized French national curriculum and IB Curriculum and framework enriched by key American courses, allowing flexibility and academic transfer to leading schools and universities worldwide. The Lycée is a unique environment that promotes initiative, autonomy, cooperation, and individual responsibility.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Business Office Manager is a hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Financial & Operating Officer (CFOO). This individual owns the integrity of the school’s accounting operations, leading the Business Office team, driving an accurate and on-time full-cycle close, maintaining general ledger accuracy including restricted and unrestricted fund tracking, and producing reliable financial reporting. The Manager also oversees key operational functions across the school’s three campuses, including campus security, student transportation, and insurance/risk management. This is a working-manager role: the successful candidate leads by doing, builds strong processes and controls, and raises the quality bar of the Business Office through training, documentation, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Accounting Operations & Full-Cycle Close**

* Own the full-cycle monthly, quarterly, and year-end close, delivering an accurate close on a fixed calendar with documented checklists and review controls.
* Oversee day-to-day Business Office operations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and the general ledger in accordance with GAAP, FASB standards, and internal policies.
* Ensure expenses are coded to the correct general ledger accounts, departments, and funds; review and approve journal entries and account classifications.
* Maintain accurate tracking, release, and reporting of restricted versus unrestricted funds in accordance with donor intent and nonprofit fund accounting standards.
* Complete monthly bank reconciliations and ensure all balance sheet accounts are reconciled and reviewed on schedule.
* Ensure vendor payments are accurate and on time; establish AP review controls that prevent late or erroneous payments.
* Manage cash flow and ensure the Lycée’s cash position is optimized.
* Lead the automation of accounts payable and other manual processes; identify and implement efficiencies across financial operations.

**Team Leadership & Training**

* Manage, coach, and develop Business Office staff across all three campuses, setting clear expectations and providing performance feedback.
* Develop and document standard operating procedures for all accounting and finance functions.
* Train Business Office staff and school employees on accounting procedures, expense policies, and financial systems.

**Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Produce accurate and timely monthly financial reports for the CFOO, Board of Trustees, and department managers, including statements of activities and financial position by fund.
* Assist the CFOO with the presentation of accounting and financial data to the Board.
* Reconcile project cost records and support budget variance analysis.
* Support preparation of annual operating and capital budgets across multiple departments and funding sources.

**Compliance, Filings & Audit**

* File and manage local property tax returns and other required filings related to school operations across all three campuses.
* Ensure all annual, quarterly, and periodic federal, state, and local filings are completed accurately and on time, in compliance with requirements applicable to a nonprofit educational institution.
* Lead audit preparation: year-end schedules, adjusting entries, and responses to auditor inquiries.
* Implement and enforce accounting policies and internal controls; work cross-departmentally to ensure financial matters comply with Lycée policies and applicable law.

**Operations: Security, Transportation & Risk**

* Oversee campus security operations across all three campuses, including vendor/personnel management, coverage schedules, incident records, and functioning security systems (cameras, access controls, alarms).
* Oversee the student transportation program with assistance of Transportation Specialist.
* Monitor and oversee insurance needs across all campuses; liaise with brokers on coverage sufficiency and escalate risk matters to the CFOO and Head of School as appropriate.
* Take on other operational duties as the school evolves, which may include construction and building projects and other cross-functional initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**Required**

* A minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in finance and accounting, including ownership of a full-cycle close.
* Strong working knowledge of GAAP, FASB standards, and nonprofit fund accounting, including restricted/unrestricted fund tracking.
* Demonstrated experience supervising, training, and developing accounting staff.
* Track record of building processes and internal controls that improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Systems thinking: capacity to see and improve interconnections between accounting, operations, and compliance workflows.
* Regulatory agility: ability to track and respond to evolving local, state, and federal compliance requirements for educational nonprofits.

**Preferred**

* CPA or equivalent, or public accounting/audit background.
* Experience with Sage Intacct accounting software, Rippling, and AI tools.
* Experience with payroll registers and journals.

Pay: $115,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Work Location: I

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Project Manager (Redwood City, CA)**

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager (PM I) leads the planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of business and technology initiatives that support organizational objectives. This role manages projects from initiation through implementation and closure, including a brief post-production stabilization period. Upon successful stabilization, ownership and ongoing support are transitioned to the designated business and technology support teams.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for project delivery and partners closely with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, operational partners, and leadership to coordinate activities, manage risks, track and resolve issues, ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and drive successful outcomes that align with business goals.

While the primary focus of this role is project leadership and delivery, the Project Manager is also expected to perform Business Analyst functions when project needs require. This includes facilitating requirements gathering, documenting business and functional requirements, analyzing business processes, supporting solution design discussions, validating business needs, and assisting with testing and implementation activities. The Project Manager serves as a bridge between business and technical teams to help ensure solutions meet business objectives and operational needs.

In addition to managing assigned projects, the Project Manager plays an active role in project portfolio demand and intake management. This includes reviewing incoming project requests, ensuring requests are properly documented and filed within the project intake system, validating completeness of submitted information, coordinating follow-up activities as needed, and maintaining visibility into the project demand pipeline.

**Essential Functions**  
Essential Functions
  
Project Implementation & Delivery
  
Lead approved and prioritized cross-functional business and technology projects from initiation through closure.
  
Ensure Vendor Management due diligence requirements have been completed by the project owner prior to project implementation.  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies in partnership with project sponsors and stakeholders.  
  
Develop and maintain risk registers, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation strategies, and contingency plans, to minimize organizational exposure and project risk.  
  
Develop project work plans, schedules, key milestones, and target dates; drive project execution and adjust plans as necessary to ensure successful delivery of committed outcomes.  
  
Effectively apply PMO methodologies and enforce project governance, implementation, and delivery standards.  
  
Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete, current, and maintained within approved repositories.  
  
Business Analysis & Solution Validation  
  
Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, vendors, and technical teams.  
  
Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.  
  
Analyze current-state and future-state business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.  
  
Validate proposed solutions with stakeholders and confirm business needs, requirements, and project objectives have been addressed.  
  
Testing, Implementation & Operational Readiness  
  
Coordinate testing activities, user acceptance testing, implementation planning, deployment readiness, and go-live activities.  
  
Partner with impacted business units to ensure operational procedures, departmental workflows, job aids, training materials, and supporting documentation are developed or updated to reflect new or modified processes, systems, controls, regulatory requirements, and operational changes introduced by the project.  
  
Ensure all tracked issues, defects, risks, and action items are resolved, mitigated, formally accepted, or appropriately documented prior to deployment.  
  
Confirm stakeholder expectations have been met and obtain final approval and signoff from impacted business owners and the appropriate Vice President(s) prior to production deployment.  
  
Facilitate a successful transition to operational ownership and support following implementation and stabilization.  
  
Portfolio Intake & Demand Management  
  
Support administration and management of the project portfolio demand and intake pipeline.  
  
Ensure project requests are appropriately documented, categorized, tracked, and routed through the intake process.  
  
Maintain accurate intake and portfolio records to support project prioritization, capacity planning, and portfolio reporting.  
  
Provide visibility into project demand, resource needs, and portfolio pipeline status to leadership.  
  
**Knowledge & Business Acumen**

**Financial & Operational Management**  

* Understand project budgeting, financial planning, and cost management principles.
* Understand cost-benefit analysis and business case development.
* Understand vendor contracts, project-related legal documents, and procurement processes.

**Technical Knowledge**  

* Understand software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and information technology concepts.
* Understand web-based, cloud, internet, and client-server architectures.
* Awareness of emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Proficiency with project management and business analysis tools, including Microsoft Project, OneNote, Visio, Jira, Microsoft Office Suite, MS Teams, and other tools.

  
**Analytical & Communication Skills**

* Ability to synthesize complex information from multiple stakeholders, business units, vendors, and technical team

**About DCL Logistics**

For over 40 years, DCL Logistics has powered the brands that shape how the world shops. We are a modern 3PL and a technology company at heart, trusted by high-growth, innovative names in consumer electronics, health and beauty, wellness, and connected devices. Our proprietary platforms (eFactory, SelectShip, and ReturnTrak) give our clients full command of their supply chain, and our ISO 9001:2015 certified facilities deliver the precision and quality their customers expect. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with a national network reaching 96% of the U.S. population on two-day ground, we help ambitious brands scale without limits.

**Why DCL**

We are more than a fulfillment company. We are a team of people who make it happen. Our culture is built on four core values that show up in everything we do: Make It Happen, Be Resourceful, Deliver Operational Excellence, and We Care. Here, your work is visible, your ideas matter, and your impact is real from day one. We move fast, we hold ourselves to the highest standard, and we take care of our people. When you join DCL, you don't just join an organization. You join a family.

**Location Requirements:**

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must currently reside within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the following locations: Louisville, KY; York, PA; the San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Perris, CA; Ontario, CA; or the greater Southern California area.

**About the Role**

The Project Manager (PM) will lead internal initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, and performance across our fulfillment network. This role is focused on both **operational execution** and **IT project delivery**—driving cross-functional initiatives, implementing systems, and standardizing processes that support our warehouse operations and technology platforms. The Project Manager will partner with stakeholders across operations, IT, engineering, customer service and leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact.

This role reports directly to the Company President.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage cross-functional projects end-to-end: scope, timeline, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.
* Serve as the central point of coordination between IT, Operations, Accounting, and other functional teams, translating each group's priorities and constraints into a shared project plan.
* Run regular status meetings, steering committee updates, and stakeholder check-ins; maintain clear, consistent project documentation (charters, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify and resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, conflicting priorities, and resource contention before they become blockers.
* Establish and improve lightweight project management standards, templates, and governance so future cross-functional work doesn't have to start from scratch.
* Track project health (scope, schedule, budget, risk) and escalate proactively when a project is at risk.
* Partner with functional managers to ensure resources are allocated appropriately without disrupting day-to-day departmental operations.
* Support post-project reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* **PMP Certified with 3–6 years o**f project management experience in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or IT project delivery.
* Strong understanding of fulfillment and warehouse operations, as well as related technology systems.
* Experience leading IT projects involving WMS, OMS, ERP, or ecommerce integrations.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in project management tools (Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or equivalent).
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or ITIL certification a plus.

This role ensures clear communication of the project schedule and deliverables among clients, designers, and the production team.

jobs.title: Model Operations Lead, AI Gateway
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York City, NY | San Francisco, CA**

### **About AI Gateway**

AI inference is becoming core infrastructure. Every serious application will need access to many models across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare's bet that this layer belongs at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change.

Developers using AI Gateway need answers to two questions. Is the model I'm calling working the way you say it does? And which model should I be using at all? You'll lead the models team that answers both.

You'll start with model operations. That's the work behind every model in the catalog: provider integrations, capability testing, pricing and metering, capacity, security reviews, docs, health, and deprecations. Sometimes a launch needs to go live within minutes of a lab's announcement. Sometimes the right call is to hold it. Cloudflare is an infrastructure company at heart, so reliability and accuracy come first; speed comes from preparation and automation.

Then you'll bring model intelligence online. That means turning what we learn from Gateway traffic into decisions for customers: capability maps, per-task rankings, auto-routing profiles that pick the right model for each request, evals and regression detection, and market intelligence developers can trust.

This is a people-management role reporting to the AI Gateway Engineering Manager. You'll hire, develop, and lead the team, and you'll stay hands-on: writing code, building agent-driven workflows, and getting into the details of a failed launch or a suspicious eval SLO. Expect to manage people, projects, model stock, and operations all at once.

### **About the Role**

* **Build and lead the models team:** Hire, coach, and grow the people who run the catalog today and build its intelligence over time. Give people real ownership, give direct feedback, and grow leads who can run their own areas.
* **Run model launches end-to-end:** Scope integrations, coordinate testing and evals, confirm pricing, metering, capacity, and security, and get docs and announcements ready. Prepare day-zero launches in advance so they can ship in minutes.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategy & AI Enablement
jobs.description:
**About Holtzbrinck and the AI Hub**

Holtzbrinck is one of the world's leading media companies. We're home to Springer Nature, Macmillan Publishers, Macmillan Learning, DIE ZEIT, and Digital Science, with a portfolio spanning science, education, literature, and journalism. Our values, curiosity, commitment, and passion, carried us to over 14,000 people, more than 120 countries, and over USD 4 billion in revenue.

Based in San Francisco, the AI Hub sits at the intersection of a global media group and the world's most vibrant AI ecosystem. We shape the group's AI strategy, build partnerships with leading AI labs, run programs that grow AI capability across our companies, and invest in what comes next. We work directly with the Executive Board, leaders and builders across the portfolio.

**The role**

Our portfolio companies employ thousands of people whose work is changing because of AI. Your job is to make that change deliberate. You own the programs that turn curiosity into capability: from our San Francisco Residency Program, where portfolio talent explore their AI-related ideas for up to three months in San Francisco, to Functional AI Leadership Weeks that bring our functional leaders, driving the AI transformation together with partners, startups and thought leaders.

**What you will do**

* Run our Residency Program end to end: cohort selection, onboarding, curriculum
* Build a strong alumni network of global AI talent across Holtzbrinck
* Design and deliver Functional AI Leadership Weeks, including playbooks, agendas, and speaker curation
* Plan and facilitate leadership offsites and enablement workshops
* Own regular meetings across AI leaders and builders and build it into a genuine community across portfolio companies
* Drive the AI Hub's internal and external communications, including our newsletter and event comms
* Measure what matters: participation, satisfaction, and real adoption per cycle, reported to leadership

**What success looks like**

* Our Residency Program runs at full capacity with a waitlist, and the prototype-to-deployment rate exceeds benchmarks
* Every major function has been through a Functional AI Week within 18 months, with each week producing implementation next steps that significantly drive our internal AI transformation
* Portfolio executives request your workshops instead of being sent to them
* Holtzbrinck’s AI communities are places where portfolio companies learn from each other
* People at Holtzbrinck say the AI Hub programs have been instrumental in advancing their AI initiatives and strategy.

**What you bring**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, innovation, management, or a related field, ideally with a focus on technology, data, or business development.
* 2+ years of experience in AI strategy, innovation management or product strategy, ideally within a science, education or media.
* Technical fluency; you collaborate with AI tools every day, can read a demo critically, and are proactively following the latest AI developments.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with external partners, whether AI companies, academic institutions, or startups.

**Salary:** $120,000

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.  
  
Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.  
  
A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.  
  
No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Who is HearingLife:**

HearingLife is a national hearing care company and global leader in hearing healthcare built on a heritage of care, health and innovation since 1904. HearingLife operates more than 600 hearing care centers across 42 states. We help patients every day through personalized care and hearing aid devices. We follow a scientific, results-oriented approach to hearing healthcare that is provided by highly skilled and caring professionals. Our vision is to help more people hear better through life-changing hearing health delivered by the best personalized care.

**Pay**: $22-24 hour + Monthly Commission Opportunities

**Benefits:**

* PTO & Paid Holidays
* Work-Life balance is VERY important to us!
* Medical, dental, vision, and HSA
* 401K+ Match
* Maternity Leave
* Short Term and Long-Term Disability coverage
* Free Life Insurance
* Pet Insurance
* Steeply discounted Hearing Aids and Products for you and your family members.
* Daycare Flex Savings Plan
* Growth and development opportunities

Responsibilities:

You will act as the face of our retail clinics located around the country and in local communities. The Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) strives to ensure a positive patient experience and to help more people hear better. You do this by supporting the clinic to achieve revenue goals by attracting new patients, managing the administrative and operational functions and coordinating patient interactions and needs.

**Daily Tasks:**

* Welcome all patients and maintain high level of customer service
* Inbound and outbound phone calls, 50-75 per day
* Schedule & confirm all patient appointments
* PPI Intake and processing
* Collect and verify medical insurance information for patients
* Ordering and receiving office supplies
* Payment processing
* Hearing Aid supplies inventory management
* Maintain office cleanliness
* Uphold and maintain all HIPPA standards

**Growth Opportunities at HearingLife for Patients Care Coordinators!**

* Comprehensive Onboarding: At HearingLife, we're committed to empowering our Team Members to excel in their roles from day one. We believe in providing a comprehensive onboarding program designed to equip individuals with the knowledge and skills necessary for success.
* Hearing Instrument Specialist Apprentice Program: Learn how to be a Hearing Aid Specialist by completing clinical hours alongside a trained professional. Once completed be the provider in your own office, seeing patients and enhancing lives with hearing aid. Ask a manger about this program!
* District Manager In-Training Program: Learn the tools necessary to become a leader in the hearing aid industry.

Qualifications:

* **Education and Experience**
* + High school diploma or GED required; college degree preferred.
  + Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a customer service, administrative, or healthcare-related role.
* **Skills and Abilities**
* + Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written).
  + Exceptional organizational skills with attention to detail.
  + Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  + Comfortable using technology, including scheduling software and electronic medical records (EMR) systems.

*We are an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

jobs.title: Patient Services Representative - VVWC OB/GYN (Full Time, Day)
jobs.description:
At Northbay Health, the Patient Services Representative II performs general front office duties of moderate scope and complexity including reception, registration, appointment scheduling, insurance verification and medical records management functions. The Patient Services Representative II exercises judgment within defined guidelines and functions as part of a clerical and customer service team in support of Ambulatory Division medical practices.

**Primary Job Duties**

Performs independently all of Level 1, in addition but not limited to the following:

**Registration and Charge Entry**

* Gathers, updates and verifies a comprehensive package of registration and insurance/payer information and ensures accurate entry into the EMR.
* Provides information to patients regarding the selection process of a care provider, assists in determining insurance eligibility, co-payments, share of costs and other financial responsibilities for services rendered. Obtains signatures on required forms.
* Verifies and documents eligibility for all payers at the time of service.
* Reviews benefit plan/s with patient to determine specific allowances and/or restrictions based on services requested.
* Researches and answers inquiries related to claims, eligibility and referrals.
* Collects co-payments, deposits and fees, reconciling all payments at the end of their shift.
* Ensures the accuracy of demographic and insurance information in accordance with the policies, procedures and service expectations of each department.
* Maintains professional standards by actively participating in committees, inservices and QI activities and standards development.
* Acts as a resource to new and existing staff in areas of subject matter expertise.
* Presents a professional demeanor in appearance and attitude.
* Serves as a job expert in assigned areas.
* Provides orientation to new staff as assigned.
* Floats to other areas, as requested.
* Performs other duties, as assigned.

**Appointment Scheduling and Reception**

* Obtains complete demographic information for new patients ensuring accurate entry into the EMR. Confirms and accurately updates demographic information for existing patients.
* May confirm eligibility and PCP assignment status (Primary Care) for patients prior to scheduling appointment.
* Demonstrates effective listening and problem-solving skills to determine appropriate call routing.
* Schedules appointments on the phone or in person in accordance with approved protocols and current scheduling policies, procedures and algorithms
* Assists with referral coordination/scheduling (Specialty Care).
* Monitors provider schedules to ensure appointments are booked for correct type and correct time allocation.
* Proactively manages provider schedules for optimal patient access and no-show reduction.
* Places confirmation or rescheduling calls in accordance with scripted guidelines and current policy and procedures.
* Assists in physician schedule maintenance functions including coordination of physician absences with open appointment times.
* Gathers data for provider access audits; provide appointment access for KPI’s.
* Greets and welcomes patients and assists them with initial questions regarding appointments, payments, schedules, etc.

**Medical Records**

* Adheres to System policies related confidentiality of medical record information, transcription and copies or distribution of medical record content.
* Handles patient documents appropriately to ensure patient confidentiality. Includes handling of medical records outside designated storage area.
* Demonstrates understanding of PHI management and HIPAA compliance by successful completion of annual competency validation.

  

**Education**

* Some college business or computer course work preferred.
* Course work in medical terminology preferred.

**Licensure/Certification**

* Current AHA or equivalent BLS certification required within first 90 days of hire.

**Experience / Skills**

* Two years of customer engagement experience and/or service centered role required.
* Experience within a healthcare environment in medical record processes, appointment scheduling, referral and authorization processes, registration process, and back office clinical support preferred.
* Excellent customer service skills required.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills with ability to effectively articulate thoughts into a productive and meaningful discussion.
* Ability to successfully manage multiple priorities effectively and within expected timeframes.
* Working knowledge in the areas listed below, required:
  + Differentiation of the unique characteristics of the following insurance types: Medi-Cal, Medicare, Managed Care, Indemnity and Workers Compensation.
  + Impact of completeness and accuracy the registration/admission process on successful claims processing and receipt of payment.
  + Impact of completeness and accuracy the registration process on the delivery of safe, high quality patient care.
  + Organizational process and procedures.
  + NorthBay Health’s Clinical computer systems.
* Demonstrated service excellence including, but not limited to professionalism, customer focus, compassion, strong listening skills and a warm demeanor.
* Consistently exhibits empathy, optimism, resourcefulness and cultural competency in interactions with others.
* Open to learning new things and partnering with others in a collaborative environment.
* Proven track record of conducting him/herself in a manner that demonstrates an understanding of the unique complexities and challenges of the healthcare environment.
* Strong organizational skills.

**Physical Effort**

* Attendance is an essential function of the job.
* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
* Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essenti

jobs.title: Contact Center Administrative Supervisor
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Supervises clinic operations, typically spanning multiple providers, clinics and/or practices. Subordinates include staff involved with professional operational functions. Oversight of administrative areas such as practice revenue management, billing systems and procedures, facilities and safety procedures, registration, new patient coordination, scheduling, medical records storage and maintenance, insurance authorizations. May also supervise patient support staff such as medical assistants or LVNs, in coordination with the nursing lead.

The Administrative Supervisor provides frontline operational leadership and direct supervision for practice coordinators and team leads within the UCSF Health Contact Center, Referral and Access Centers, and Call Center. Reporting to the Administrative Manager, this role ensures daily execution of high-quality referral, scheduling, and access services while maintaining real-time operational stability, staff performance, and continuous improvement. The Administrative Supervisor plays a critical role in supporting pod-level performance, resolving escalations, and delivering exceptional patient and provider experience.

* Provide direct daily supervision, coaching, and tactical oversight to practice coordinators and team leads, including real-time monitoring of referral workqueues, inbound call queues, and key performance metrics.
* Review and update work schedules daily to ensure accurate staffing assignments, confirm adherence to projections, and achieve target adherence rates.
* Handle daily communications and escalations by responding to inquiries from staff, team leads, and Home Team (emails, chats, calls, etc.), while checking and actioning personal electronic medical record In-Box messages.
* Manage attendance and timekeeping processes including review and approval of time-off requests, timesheets, attendance tracking, and follow-up on attendance trends.
* Lead and/or attend various meetings (e.g.,1:1 meetings with the Manager and Team Leads,
* Leadership Meetings, Home Team Huddles, Team Huddles)
* Monitor pod performance, respond to service level escalations, and escalate to the Manager as appropriate.
* Submit quality assurance tickets, review issue tracking items, coordinate resolutions with stakeholders, and complete the Leader Standard Work Tracker.
* Conduct monthly 1:1 meetings with practice coordinators and team leads, review screen-recorded calls for quality coaching, and support HR compliance activities.
* Support the professional development of team through updating development plan trackers for direct reports

jobs.title: Manager, Product Management - Global Program Enablement
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Team Summary:

The Global Consumer Card Products group manages the deployment and optimization of Visa’s core products base consisting of Credit, Debit and Prepaid payments solutions globally. The team is also responsible for the development and deployment of innovation across this product suite such as stablecoin and cross-border issuance programs. To do this, we work in partnership with Visa clients and key internal and external stakeholders across the globe. We are also the team responsible for leading the transition of conventional card-based solutions onto digital form factors, ensuring Visa payments solutions remain the market-leading way for consumers to spend their money and manage their payments across Visa’s global regions.

What the Manager, Product Management does at Visa:

Visa is seeking a Manager, Product Management to support the evolution and operational excellence of Visa's Program Enrollment ecosystem supporting Stablecoin, Crypto, and Cross-Border Issuance programs. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, risk management, operations, compliance, and client enablement. The successful candidate will own the end-to-end product experience for program assessment & onboarding processes, ensuring that innovative payment solutions can scale globally while maintaining alignment with Visa rules, AML requirements, regulatory expectations, and operational standards. The role will focus on evaluating complex program structures, driving program modernization initiatives, identifying process improvement opportunities, and partnering across Product, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Regional teams, and external clients to accelerate program approvals and launches.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Review & Governance:

* Lead reviews of Program Enrollments for Stablecoin, Crypto, and Cross-Border Issuance programs.
* Assess program structures, funding models, operating models, customer journeys, and partner ecosystems.
* Evaluate program documentation including program descriptions and value propositions; transaction flows and flow-of-funds diagrams; AML, sanctions, KYC, and transaction monitoring frameworks; third-party agent and partner relationships; and cross-border issuance structures and country expansion plans

Product & Process Innovation:

* Help define and execute the product roadmap for program modernization and operational transformation initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to simplify client onboarding, leveraging AI to improve submission quality, and reduce review cycle times.
* Develop scalable review frameworks, approval workflows, and automation opportunities.
* Drive improvements to submission tools, operational processes, client guidance, and review methodologies.
* Analyze review data and operational metrics to identify bottlenecks and improve overall program throughput.

Stakeholder Management:

* Serve as a key point of coordination between Product, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Regional Product, Account Executives, and Operations teams.
* Develop executive-level communications, reporting, and recommendations.
* Create client-facing guidance, best practices, and educational materials to improve submission quality and client experience.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment on strategic priorities and operational improvements.

Why this is important to Visa:

This role is critical to Visa's ability to scale next-generation payment solutions globally.

As Stablecoin, Crypto, and Cross-Border Issuance programs continue to grow, Visa must balance innovation with strong governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance. The Manager, Product Management will help ensure that clients can bring new payment products to market efficiently while maintaining the integrity of Visa's network and compliance standards.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or related field.
* 5+ years’ experience in product management, payments, credit products, or financial services.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit products, payment technology, and emerging fintech solutions. Experience with Stablecoin products preferred.
* Technical fluency and ability to translate complex requirements into actionable product features.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a matrixed, global organization with cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical skills and business acumen, with experience in performance tracking and reporting.

jobs.title: Program Manager II, Compliance, YouTube
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in compliance, information security, IT audit, or risk management.
* Experience creating regulatory compliance reports and briefings.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience advising Product and Engineering teams on compliance issues.
* Effective communication skills verbally and in writing.
* Attention to detail with a bias toward action.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

This team partners across product, engineer, and operations to manage legal obligations end-to-end, getting and staying compliant across the globe. Our teams lead cross-functional working groups to design and implement the appropriate compliance strategy for incoming laws. We manage compliance long term, utilizing controls to measure and scale how we comply. We also handle testing, risk assessments, and issue management related to our compliance positions. We handle the Digital Services Act Audit and Systemic Risk Assessments, including cross-YouTube VP engagement to sign off on external publications.

In this role, you'll facilitate leadership engagement on critical and timely compliance topics. YouTube regularly engages Product VPs and Directors to make compliance decisions on our strategy for emerging regulatory topics. This role is designed to empower those leaders with the information they need to navigate those strategic decisions. You'll organize various compliance and related Product perspectives into executive briefings, reports, and other similar updates. You'll facilitate regular thematic updates to teams across YouTube, and support ongoing YouTube-wide program health. This is a truly cross-functional opportunity that connects across many teams, including within YouTube and across Google.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. jobs.title: Farmers Market Market Manager (Program Manager I)
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Farmers Market Market Manager (Program Manager I)

**Reporting To:** Farmers' Market Program Manager (Program Manager III)

**FLSA Status:** Non- Exempt, Hourly

**Summary**
===========

The Farmers' Market Manager works onsite to lead, set up, manage, and break-down Ecology Center's farmers' markets. In collaboration with the Program Manager and/or the Operations Manager, or alone, the Market Manager provides oversight and instruction to farmers, vendors, other market staff, and volunteers at market. The Market Manager also works in the Ecology Center office, providing operational and administrative support on non-market days. **The job involves generally working at least two market shifts per week at approximately 16 hours and 8 hours in the office each** week. Additional hours will be worked at the office, at the markets or by telecommuting based on program needs and supervisor approval. This 75% position averages around 34 hours per week.

Essential Duties

* Perform and support all duties related to operating Ecology Center Farmers' Markets in compliance with all applicable local, state and federal regulations, and in accordance with the goals and strategies of the Ecology Center mission and strategic plan.
* Manage the Ecology Center farmers' markets, serving as lead for at least one market weekly, including market set-up and breakdown, vendor parking-in, stall fee collections, signage, load list distribution and collection, info booth set-up and staffing, volunteer coordination, token distribution, and all other market activities.
* Provide on-site supervision of market staff, including Market Coordinators, regular and on- call, youth, and volunteers. Lead market operations onsite.
* Provide excellent customer service through customer interactions including token distribution, selling merchandise, and answering questions.
* Perform post-market duties including deposit preparation and financial tracking, sorting recycling/compost, cleaning soiled receptacles and/or tables, replacing and/or repairing any damaged equipment, restocking merchandise/supplies with a high degree of attention to details.
* Ensure that all market monies received are handled safely following established cash-handling procedures; oversee and assist in the preparation of market deposits within 24 hours of receipt of funds, and prepare change and tokens to be used in the following market.
* Track and report information from at-market tracking documents including market log, token distribution log, and receipt book to keep a reference of the market's activities and financials.
* Perform administrative and office duties related to the market at which Market Manager is the lead. This includes but is not limited to: following up with farmers and vendors' preparing printed materials; coordinating with local businesses, partners, neighbors and others; approving invoices; etc.
* Work with Program Manager to create agenda and attend Community Advisory Committee meetings.
* Work with the Program Manager, Operations Manager, and other Market Managers to determine vendor mix and lead market layout as seasons change.
* Assist the Program Manager in developing and implementing promotional efforts for the Farmers' Markets
* Work with Program Manager and Events Coordinator to plan, execute, and promote farmers' market events which help meet the organization and program'

goals and mission. This includes liaising with farmers' market staff, farmers and vendors to ensure successful event execution; and assisting with event set-up and logistics on event days.

* Perform general administrative duties including answering phones, responding to emails, attending meetings and events.
* Observe safe operating practices and comply with organizational safety policies including reporting incidents according to our procedures.
* Maintain familiarity with, follow, and ensure staff compliance with all Ecology Center policies and procedures in the performance of daily duties.
* Administrate the creation and publishing of relevant, original, high-quality content for social media platforms both at market and as part of office duties in accordance with our regular publishing schedule.
* Identify and improve organizational development aspects that would improve content (ie: employee training, recognition and rewards for participation in the organization's marketing and online strategies)
Lead Farmers' Markets tour initiative* -from training volunteers to contacting organizations and organizing tours year round focused on specific topics and seasons.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The proven ability to work independently and exercise good judgment in a variety of environments and situations.
* Proven ability to manage on-site and office operations for the farmers' market or similar small business enterprise.
* Competency with word processing, spreadsheet, database in a Mac computer environment and ability and willingness to learn new applications as needed.
* Proven ability and enthusiasm for developing and maintaining relationships with participants including farmers, vendors, customers, neighbors and other members of the public
* Demonstrable ability to effectively resolve conflicts
* The ability and willingness to monitor and enforce policies with vendors and the public.
* Flexibility and creativity, ability to "think on your feet" and find appropriate solutions to unique challenges.
* Strong verbal and written communications skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Special Requirements

* **Must be able to produce a current CA driver's license.**

* First Aid and CPR
