jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Seneca is seeking a **Business Operations Lead** to run strategic finance, accounting, contracts, insurance, compliance, purchasing, payroll and benefits, and the office. Right now those things are spread across an outside accounting firm, a payroll vendor, outside counsel, a fractional Head of Ops and the CEO. As we continue to scale, we are seeking someone who can up-level this organization both in terms of our daily operations and in key moments like M+A, equity and debt financings, key partnerships etc.

This role reports to the CEO with tight partnership. There will be opportunity to hire and/or bring in additional outside resources over the next twelve months.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Finance & Accounting**

* You run the finance function. Both FP&A and accounting.
* Partner with teams to ensure they pick the right strategies for both cost and revenue optimization as Seneca scales.
* Own the monthly close with our outside accounting firm.
* Get the accounting right for a hardware company moving into production: inventory, BOMs, capitalized R&D, fixed assets, and revenue recognition on multi-year contracts with agencies and utilities.
* Handle invoicing and collections, including milestone billing on government and utility contracts.
* Figure out the right policies for expense management and suggest our monthly budget – keeping us tracking to it.
* Keep the budget and board package current.

**Contracts, Compliance & Risk**

* Own contracts. Work with outside counsel on customer agreements, supplier terms, NDAs, and government contracting paperwork. Know what we have signed and what it commits us to.
* Own insurance, including aviation and product liability. For a drone company this is real work.
* Keep the compliance calendar: corporate filings, state registrations, export controls, and the requirements that come with selling to public agencies.

**Purchasing & Vendors**

* Run purchasing so engineers can get what they need fast and we still know where the money went: approvals, corporate cards, expense policy, vendor setup.
* Negotiate large vendor and supplier agreements.
* Partner with outside lawyers on where to draw the lines on NDAs, partnership agreements, and any other day to day legal questions.

**People Operations**

* Oversee payroll, benefits, and the HRIS through our vendors.
* Help us continue to drive exceptional recruitment.
* Own compensation and equity: bands, offers, grants, refreshes, and the promotion process, with the CEO.
* Make sure the basics are covered: I-9s, multi-state registrations, handbook, required trainings. Bring in outside HR counsel when a situation calls for it.
* Be someone employees can come to in confidence when something is wrong.

**Systems & the Office**

* Own the finance and ops systems (Ramp, Rippling, Carta, QuickBooks) and decide when to replace one.
* Run the Sausalito office: lease, facilities, IT and security basics, equipment. There are others in the loop here, but you have the opportunity to formalize facilities.

**What You Bring**
------------------

This is a high visibility / high upside role for a candidate who wants to be an early strategic partner to an experienced CEO in a high impact, high growth startup. You’ll often partner with the CEO, so a history of excellence is valued.

* Experience in strategic finance or private equity and/or investment banking
* You have run finance and operations at a venture-backed startup, ideally one that builds hardware, through a period of real growth.
* You understand accounting well enough to manage an outside firm and catch their mistakes: GAAP, revenue recognition, inventory, capitalized R&D.
* You are a generalist and you like operating. You fix things rather than write about them.
* You love to design scalable operational processes, including automating manual workflows, identifying future bottlenecks, and evaluating tools, partners, and vendors for long-term scalability
* You handle confidential information with care.
* You write and speak plainly, and you can explain business concepts to anyone.
* You want to work in person in Sausalito.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive Salary** — Reflective of your skills and experience
* **Equity Compensation** — Be an owner in the company's future
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** — Medical, dental, and vision plans
* **Health Savings Account (HSA)** — Optional pre-tax savings for medical expenses
* **Unlimited PTO** — Flexible time off to recharge, plus paid company holidays

**About Us**  
Seneca is building cutting-edge drone and sensor technology for wildfire suppression, aiming to eliminate wildfire risk across 500 million acres of high-risk U.S. + allied territory. Backed by top-tier investors, including Convective Capital, Caffeinated Capital, First Round Capital, Slow Ventures, Nextview Ventures, Transition Capital, Bullpen Capital, Stepstone Group, Roar Capital, Offline Ventures, and leaders from Palantir, Google, Meta, and many others. Founded by Stu Landesberg (former Founder & CEO of Grove Collaborative — IPO in 2022 at $1.7B) and fire industry experts, Seneca is a mission-driven company dedicated to climate resilience and fire prevention.

**Don’t meet every single requirement?** If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply — you may still be the right fit for our team.

Compensation Range: $125K - $200K

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US:**

Founded in 2022, **ForzaCare** is a purpose-driven organization that helps injured individuals recover faster and return to work safely through coordinated, clinically appropriate care. Our name reflects our mission - Forza means "strength," representing the power of our team, and *Care* reflects our compassion for those we serve.

* Coordinate care between medical providers, employers, insurance carriers, and injured workers.
* Attend appointments with the injured workers, which may include visiting employers and injured workers at their place of employment.

* Ensure all case management work meets or exceeds customer and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, providers, and internal team members.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Education & Licensure:**

* Active Registered Nurse (RN) or Certified Rehabilitation Counselor (CRC) license with associated college degree is required.
* Additional certifications such as CCM**,** CIRS, or other case management credentials are preferred.
* Must comply with all state-specific licensure and certification requirements.
* **Prior experience in workers' compensation case management is strongly preferred.**
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and auto insurance with ability to travel to appointments.

jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW: Supervise the daily operations of the Front Desk staff to maximize revenues and profits while attaining optimal guest satisfaction.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

1. Interview, hire, train, recommend performance evaluations, resolve problems, provide open communication and recommend discipline and/or termination when appropriate.

2. Respond to guest’s special requests, needs, problems, issues and concerns and accommodate groups to ensure optimal levels of guest satisfaction and repeat business.

3. Implement company programs and supervise the daily operations of the Front Desk to comply with SOPS and LSOPs, maximize revenues, and motivate associates to ensure an optimal level of quality service and hospitality are provided to the hotel customers.

4. Supervise the Guest Service Agents.

5. Remain calm and alert, especially during emergency situations and/or heavy hotel activity, serving as a role model for clerks and other employees. Resolve customer complications and complaints by conducting thorough research of the situation and determining the most effective solutions. Make decisions and take action based on previous experience and good judgment, sometimes revising approach to accommodate unusual situation. Authorize revenue allowances to remedy problems only after other alternative solutions have been offered.

6. Comply with attendance rules and be available to work on a regular basis.

7. Perform any other job related duties as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Must have the ability to communicate in English. Self-starting personality with an even disposition. Maintain a professional appearance and manner at all times. Can communicate well with guests. Must be willing to “pitch-in” and help co- workers with their job duties and be a team player. Ability to effectively deal with internal and external customers, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger and collect accurate information and resolve conflicts. Basic mathematical skills and considerable skill in the use of a calculator to prepare moderately complex mathematical calculations without error. Ability to access and accurately input information using a moderately complex computer system. Ability to stand, walk and continuously perform behind the front desk. Ability to observe and detect signs of emergency situations. Ability to communicate verbally and in writing and prepare complex reports of room availability and revenues generated. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with associates, customers and patrons.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Customer Satisfaction:

Our customers are what we are about. One of the keys to a positive guest experience is positive interaction with Crescent staff. It is essential that you remain professional at all times, and that you treat all guests and associates with courtesy and respect, under all circumstances. Every Crescent associate is a guest relations ambassador, every working minute of every day.

Work Habits:

In order to maintain a positive guest and associate experience, your work habits should always meet and strive to exceed hotel standards for work procedures, dress, grooming, punctuality and attendance. You should be adaptable to change in your work area and in hotel procedures with a willingness to learn new skills and/or improve existing ones, have the ability to solve routine problems that occur on the job and ask for help whenever you are not sure how to do something.

  

Safety & Security:

The safety and security of our guests and associates is of utmost importance to Crescent. Every Crescent associate should adhere to the hotel security policies and procedures, particularly regarding key controls, lifting heavy objects, using chemicals, and effectively reporting safety hazards and safety concerns.

jobs.title: Intensive Care Coordination/Support Counselor
jobs.description:
**Intensive Care Coordination/****Support Counselor - San Mateo, CA**

The Support Counselor works in the field, in collaboration with the treatment team, supporting families and children within the AFS Mental Health Program. The Support Counselor’s primary focus is care coordination, using the principles of the Integrated Core Practice Model to help the families identify the members of a strong treatment team and helping them work together in a collaborative way that centers the voice and choice of the child and the family in the plan of their care. The role of Intensive Care Coordinator also include scheduling and facilitating Child and Family Team Meetings. The Support Counselor also holds cases that they provide behavioral interventions for in the child’s home, school or community to support the goals of the Mental Health Therapist on the team. This is a highly collaborative role supporting system involved children and youth and their families, providing a variety of interventions and support services to the child. Documenting sessions, collateral contacts and Child and Family Team meetings. Looking for a meaningful career where you can make a positive impact on your community? This is a full-time role. Apply today!

**About Alternative Family Services**

Alternative Family Services is a Foster Family, Adoption and Mental Health Agency that has been serving abused and neglected children in our community since 1973. Our mission is to support vulnerable children and families in need of stability, safety, and well-being in communities. We provide a wide range of foster, adoption, mental health and transition-aged youth services in English and Spanish. We have eight locations throughout the Bay Area and over 200 employees. We celebrate diversity, equal opportunity, and excellence.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide support services to the child and foster family via methods consistent with the agency’s treatment philosophy and approach
* Provide a variety of interventions. This may include, but is not limited to, coaching, mentoring, skill building, tutoring and supportive feedback
* Provide emergency response. Some evenings and weekends may be required.
* Ensure the safety and well-being of the foster child at all times
* Transport children to a variety of appointments and or settings using a personal vehicle in safe working order
* Submit written documentation of such visitations and or activities to CPS workers
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA privacy practices
* Adhere to our attendance and punctuality policy
* Assume other duties as assigned by supervisor

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Obtain and maintain fingerprint and government and Agency required background clearances

jobs.title: Functional Medicine Health Coach
jobs.description:
**About Root Rx**

Root Rx is a physician-led functional health program built for high-achieving women who are exhausted, dismissed, and done settling for “your labs look normal.” We run advanced functional lab panels, build individualized root-cause protocols, and walk clients through implementation with a dedicated coaching team. Our clients are women dealing with fatigue, hormone imbalance, thyroid dysfunction, gut issues, burnout, and metabolic challenges, and they come to us because conventional medicine hasn’t given them answers.

We’re a fast-growing virtual practice serving women ages 35 to 75. We’re looking for an experienced Functional Medicine Health Coach who shares our mission and wants to help these women finally feel like themselves again.

**The Role**

We are looking for an experienced health coach with a strong background in client-facing coaching and, ideally, experience in functional medicine, hormone health, and nutrition and lifestyle change. You will work alongside our Chief Medical Officer, Head of Coaching, and medical team to guide our growing client base through their protocols, translating clinical recommendations into daily habits, keeping clients accountable, and supporting them through every phase of their program.

This is a part-time W2 position with a path to full-time as our client base grows. You work remotely. You bring the coaching skill and the client connection. We bring the clients, the clinical team, the systems, and the mission.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coach clients 1:1 through every phase of their program, building the trust and accountability that turn a protocol into lasting change (group coaching experience is a plus)
* Interpret functional blood work, DUTCH and Hormone Zoomer, and GI-MAP, GI Effects, and Gut Zoomer panels with confidence and clinical curiosity
* Connect findings across tests to identify the root-cause drivers behind each client’s symptoms
* Build personalized nutrition, movement, stress, and sleep plans that fit real lives, not textbook ones
* Recommend targeted supplement protocols matched to each client’s root drivers
* Track progress, adjust plans as clients respond, and celebrate the wins along the way
* Partner with our Chief Medical Officer and medical team, escalating clinical concerns and bringing complex cases forward for review

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required:**

* Health coaching certification from a recognized program (NBHWC, FMCA, FDN-P, or equivalent)
* At least 1 years of experience coaching clients 1:1 in functional medicine, hormone health, or gut health
* Demonstrated proficiency interpreting functional blood work, DUTCH and Hormone Zoomer, and GI-MAP, GI Effects, and Gut Zoomer panels, including connecting findings across tests
* Experience building personalized nutrition, lifestyle, and supplement protocols based on root-cause findings
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you’ll be working with high-achieving clients who ask smart questions
* Reliable internet connection and a professional remote work setup

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Advanced functional medicine training (IFM, FDN, or similar)
* Experience working alongside a physician or medical team in a functional or integrative practice
* Group coaching experience
* Experience supporting women through perimenopause, menopause, thyroid dysfunction, or burnout

**You’re a great fit if you:**

* Are passionate about helping women who’ve been overlooked by conventional medicine
* Thrive in a fast-paced, growing practice and roll with change
* Are highly organized and manage a full client load without dropping details
* Can explain complex findings in plain, compassionate language

**Please read before applying:**

This role is for experienced functional medicine coaches. You must already be proficient in interpreting functional blood work, DUTCH and Hormone Zoomer, and GI-MAP, GI Effects, and Gut Zoomer panels, and in connecting findings across tests to identify root causes.

We do not train on lab interpretation. We’ll train you on the Root Rx process, systems, and client experience, but the clinical interpretation skills need to come with you. Applications that don’t show this experience will not move forward.

**Compensation and Structure**

* 100% remote, open to coaches anywhere in the world
* 30–40 hours/week, with availability for US evenings and weekends
* W2 for US-based coaches; independent contractor outside the US

**How to Apply**

Send the following to jennifer@rootrxhealth.com:

* Your resume or CV, including your coaching certification and any functional medicine training
* **A short introduction video** (2 to 3 minutes): Introduce yourself and tell us how you use root-cause medicine in your coaching today. We’d like to hear about the types of clients you work with, how you approach lab findings, and why this work matters to you. No need for polished production; a phone recording is perfect. We want to see how you communicate, since that’s what our clients will experience.

We review applications on a rolling basis. We look forward to hearing from you!

Pay: From $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Health coaching: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

**Position Overview:**

Amatriot is seeking a **Lead Business Analyst** to support a high-visibility program with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). =========================

* Lead end-to-end business analysis efforts for VA systems and applications, from discovery through implementation and validation.

* Perform impact analysis for change requests and enhancements, and provide recommendations based on business value, risk, and technical feasibility.
* Collaborate with QA/testing teams to validate that delivered solutions meet documented requirements, including supporting test case creation and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Mentor and provide guidance to other business analysts on the team; support standardization of analysis practices, templates, and processes.
* Communicate status, risks, and issues related to requirements and delivery to project leadership and stakeholders in a timely and transparent manner.
* Ensure all work products comply with VA standards, including security, accessibility, and data privacy requirements.

* **8+ years** of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role, including experience in a **lead** or senior capacity.
* Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and technical requirements for complex IT systems.
* Strong experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams (product owners, developers, testers, architects).
* Hands-on experience using **Jira** as a ticketing and Agile work management system (epics, stories, workflows, dashboards, reporting).
* Proven ability to translate business needs into clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail and quality.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
=============================

* Experience supporting programs or projects for the **U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs** or other federal health/benefits agencies.
* Familiarity with VA business domains such as healthcare delivery, benefits administration, claims processing, or Veteran-facing digital services.
* Knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, Kanban) and participation in scaled Agile environments.

* Relevant certifications (e.g., CBAP, PMI-PBA, CSM, SAFe, or similar).

*Hiring & Onboarding*

* Help recruit new clinicians, including interviews and contract processing.
* Onboard new clinicians into practice systems and directories (SimplePractice, Zocdoc, Headway, CAQH, Slack and more).

*Directories, Website & Marketing*

* Maintain clinician profiles on Psychology Today and other directories.
* Keep the WRP website up to date with clinician bios, services and practice announcements.
* Send weekly patient surveys and monthly clinician feedback forms.
* Work with the team on strategies to improve the client experience and grow the practice.

*Operations*

* Support daily administrative work remotely, in collaboration with the General Manager and clinic directors.
* Make sure patient portals and scheduling platforms are used efficiently.
* Be on call during business hours and respond quickly to the team by phone, Slack or email.
* Be flexible with your schedule. Issues sometimes come up on evenings or weekends that need your attention.

*Practice Growth & Strategic Support*

* Work directly with the General Manager and Owner to carry out Wellness Road’s growth initiatives.
* Help plan and carry out operational improvements, hiring goals and client acquisition strategies.
* Help track KPIs, clinician productivity and patient feedback to guide decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proficiency with CRM and practice-management software, or the ability to learn new technology quickly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort managing many moving parts across systems.
* Experience with insurance credentialing, medical billing or healthcare administration is a strong plus.

**Written Questionnaire (Required)**  
To be considered for the Operations Manager position, please complete the short written questionnaire included with your application. We’d love to learn more about you, your experience and what draws you to Wellness Road Psychology.

We’re looking for authenticity and clear communication, not perfection.

72,000 - 75,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale, complex, or multi-site projects and programs. This role serves as the senior point of contact for clients, executive stakeholders, consultants, vendors, and contractors, with full accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and reporting. The Senior Project Manager provides strategic direction throughout the project lifecycle and plays a key role in strengthening client relationships and achieving client goals.

This position may be performed in a remote, hybrid, or on-site work environment, depending on client requirements, project demands, and business needs, and may require travel based on client requirements, project needs, and business objectives. Travel frequency varies depending on project location, client expectations, portfolio size, and organizational priorities. Employees are expected to maintain effective communication, collaboration, and productivity regardless of work location.

***Requirements***

**Essential Functions**

* Lead the delivery of large, complex, high-visibility, or multi-site projects and programs from initiation through closeout.

* Lead project and steering committee meetings, ensuring clear decisions, accountability, and timely follow-up on action items.

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.  
  
We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.  
  
We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

**Location:** Remote (U.S.), with regular travel for in-person events
  
**Role type:** Full-time
  
**Reports to:** Kelly Mosher, Program Lead, Claude Corps  
**Compensation:** $130,000 to $155,000

**About Claude Corps**

In June 2026, Anthropic and CodePath launched Claude Corps, a $150M national fellowship. It places 1,000 paid, AI-skilled fellows in 12-month roles at mission-driven organizations across the country. Anthropic funds the program and sets strategy. CodePath employs the fellows and leads their training and programming.

The program is growing fast. Cohort 1 started in October 2026 with 100 fellows. Cohort 2 starts in March 2027 with 300. Cohort 3 starts in late summer 2027 with 600. Many fellows relocate to a new city for the year, so their experience, from offer letter to last day, decides whether the program works.

**About the role**

You'll be the Program Lead's right hand: a senior program manager who can take a whole area of Claude Corps, set the plan, and run it without being managed day to day. That frees Kelly to focus on program operations and strategy across the fellowship.

Your first area is the **fellow experience**, which today has no single end-to-end owner. You'll own how we communicate with, connect, and gather fellows, from offer through their last day. As the program scales, your scope will shift to wherever the biggest gap is. That could mean host organization experience or another part of the program, and future hires (for example, a community manager) may report to you.

This is a generalist role by design. We're hiring for strong program management judgment, not a single specialty.

**What success looks like**

**First 30 days: learn it and take the wheel**

* Get to know Cohort 1 (100 fellows live now), the mentor team, and our Anthropic partners
* Map the fellow journey from offer to day one, and name the three biggest gaps
* Take over day-to-day fellow communications (program inbox, fellow Slack, regular updates) from your manager
* Lock the Cohort 2 onboarding plan for 300 fellows: timeline, host matching updates, and relocation guidance

**Days 31 to 60: deliver Cohort 2 Basecamp**

* Get every Cohort 2 fellow from signed offer to day one with clear, consistent communication

**Days 61 to 90: build for scale**

* Launch a fellow support model that a small team can run for 1,000 fellows: self-serve resources, AI-assisted answers, and clear escalation to mentors, HR, and program leads
* Stand up community rituals and peer structures that don't depend on you to run
* Report engagement, satisfaction, and retention to CodePath and Anthropic leadership

**6 to 12 months**

* Cohort 3 (600 fellows) onboards on playbooks you wrote, with fewer people and fewer hours than Cohort 2
* You've documented what works so another team could pick it up and run it
* You've taken on a second program area where we need it most

**What you'll do**

* **Own the plan.** Set direction for your program area, make clear trade-offs, and tie the work to outcomes like fellow retention and engagement
* **Run the details.** Keep many workstreams moving at once and close loops without reminders
* **Communicate well.** Set honest expectations with fellows, keep the Claude Corps voice consistent, and keep host organizations informed in coordination with Anthropic's host team
* **Build systems, not heroics.** Use AI, including Claude, every day, and choose tools that let a small team serve thousands of people
* **Partner widely.** Work closely with the mentor team, curriculum, HR, outside vendors, and Anthropic partners

**What we're looking for**

**Required**

* 7+ years in program management, including owning a cohort-based program, fellowship, or member community end to end
* You've set direction for a program area yourself, not only carried out someone else's plan
* You can show how you run a heavy, changing workload: your system, what slipped once, and what you changed afterward
* You've moved work from manual to systematic, and you use AI tools hands-on in your daily work
* You write clearly and warmly and adjust your tone for fellows, executives, and partners
* You can travel to multi-day events several times a year, including February and late summer 2027

**Preferred Experience**

* Fellowships, service programs like AmeriCorps, or early-career talent programs
* Supporting participants through a relocation or major life transition
* Experience at a nonprofit, in education, or at a fast-growing startup

In this role, you will serve as the lead point of contact for transitioning complex Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and integrated infrastructure projects from contract signing to final commissioning.
  
  
As a principal individual contributor, you will directly oversee the execution of Ford Energy's most strategic and complex deployments while helping to shape and apply standardized PMO processes, delivery playbooks, and stage-gate controls for the organization. This role requires disciplined project management, proactive communication, and strong cross-functional coordination to bring each sale to life and deliver a seamless aftersales customer experience.

What you'll do...
  
  
1. Delivery Process Execution:

* Standardized Execution: Apply and help continuously improve standardized post-contract delivery processes, playbooks, and stage-gate reviews tailored for BESS projects.
* Project Health: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for project health, delivery efficiency, and financial performance across assigned Ford Energy projects.
* Tools & Systems: Utilize and provide feedback on advanced program management tools and tracking systems to ensure consistent execution.

2. High-Stakes Project Execution:

* Direct Delivery: Take personal accountability for the execution, timeline, and commissioning of Ford Energy's utility-scale BESS installations.
* Risk Mitigation: Conduct rigorous stakeholder and risk analyses to identify deployment hurdles and coordinate cross-functional interventions to unblock delivery pipelines.
* Technical & Operational Alignment: Act as the primary interface between Sales, Service, Engineering, Finance, and external EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contractors to ensure aligned execution.

3. Stakeholder & Customer Management:

* Primary Escalation Contact: Serve as the prime operational contact and consultant for customers, utilities, and senior internal leadership during project deployment.
* Contractual Coordination: Navigate and resolve complex contractual, scheduling, and technical coordination issues with external partners and utility representatives.
* Peer Mentorship: Provide functional guidance and mentorship to other project specialists and engineers across the organization.

You'll have...
  
Experience:

* 3–5+ years of project or program management experience, preferably in post-contract project execution, EPC workflows, contract management, field operations, commissioning, energy, or engineering-adjacent industries.
* Prior experience with utility-scale (BESS) project deployments.
* Proven ability to influence and drive consensus across matrixed, cross-functional engineering and business teams without direct authority.
* Prior experience translating commercial commitments or technical requirements into executable implementation and service plans.

Education:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Core Skills & Mindset:

* Process-Oriented Executor: Able to apply and reinforce standardized project delivery frameworks and PMO guidelines, ensuring operational readiness for complex deployments.
* Collaborative Facilitator: Skilled at bridging gaps and building operational consensus between Sales, Aftersales, Engineering, Finance, and external partners to drive aligned execution.
* Execution Champion: Maintains a hands-on, relentless focus on delivery timelines, quality, and project financials, ensuring our most complex commitments to customers are met successfully.
* Team Contributor: Passionate about sharing knowledge and elevating project delivery capabilities across the organization, with the readiness to foster a collaborative team culture as the function grows.

Location & Travel:

* Location: Remote or Dearborn, MI. This position operates on a hybrid model, requiring regular onsite presence to collaborate with engineering, sales, aftersales, and manufacturing team members.
* Travel Expectations: Moderate domestic travel to project sites, customer offices, and supplier locations as needed to oversee critical execution milestones.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
  + Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  + Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more
  + Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
  + Tuition assistance
  + Established and active employee resource groups
  + Paid time off for individual and team community service
  + Generous vacation time, sick/personal time, and paid holidays, including between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**What is special about Lighthouse?**

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

**What’s unique about this role?**

With the implementation of a formal Release Management Program, the Area Release Manager is the **area-level owner of release orchestration and readiness**. Releases within a given solution area are often highly interdependent — sharing teams, platforms, data, infrastructure, and milestones — so decisions or delays in one can impact others.

The Area Release Manager owns that **integrated, horizontal view across the area** — understanding how releases interconnect, sequencing them accordingly, managing cross-release dependencies and resource contention, and assessing the downstream impact of changes. The role drives tradeoffs, enforces readiness, guides release owners, and represents the area's overall delivery health to leadership — without owning the underlying product decisions or technical execution. Success requires strong portfolio judgment and the ability to drive sequencing, prioritization, dependency resolution, and go / no-go decisions under pressure.

**Core Responsibilities**

What will this person do?

* Own the integrated release plan and calendar for the solution area, maintaining a current view of all releases — including ownership, scope, status, key dates, dependencies, readiness, and delivery confidence.
* Provide area-level oversight across all releases, with individual releases driven by Release / Program Managers or other designated owners who roll status, risks, dependencies, and readiness into the area view.
* Orchestrate the area's release portfolio, aligning the teams and functions applicable to each release around an integrated plan, sequencing, dependencies, milestones, and readiness expectations.
* Drive release sequencing, prioritization, and tradeoffs across the area, balancing dependencies, capacity, resource constraints, business priorities, and readiness and bringing the appropriate leaders together to resolve competing commitments.
* Maintain an integrated view of capacity and resource constraints, identifying where concurrent releases create competing demands or delivery risk and driving resolution through adjustments to scope, timing, sequencing, priorities, or resources.
* Own the integrated dependency picture across the area, driving resolution of dependencies and handoffs among releases, teams, products, platforms, shared services, and other solution areas; escalate broader conflicts with impact, options, and a recommended path forward.
* Own the integrated risk and readiness picture for the area, ensuring material risks, issues, blockers, and readiness gaps are visible, actively managed, and escalated appropriately.
* Enforce defined readiness criteria and stage gates for each release, ensuring applicable requirements are met across the functions the release impacts and surfacing gaps early for resolution.
* Hold the area-level go / no-go decision, based on defined readiness criteria and an integrated assessment of readiness across the applicable functions; escalate unresolved readiness concerns or cross-area impacts as needed.
* Oversee execution of the release management framework within the area, ensuring defined processes, lifecycle stages, gates, governance, and ways of working are consistently applied; identify and drive resolution of process issues, ownership or handoff gaps, and breakdowns across the release lifecycle and impacted pillars.
* Guide and coordinate Release / Program Managers and other release owners across the area, reinforcing expectations for planning, reporting, risk management, readiness, governance, work-tracking discipline, and delivery quality.
* Provide a trusted, integrated view of area release health to leadership and the enterprise release process, including releases, milestones, dependencies, capacity constraints, risks, readiness, and delivery confidence; ensure accurate, timely information is maintained in the designated system of record.

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:**

* Extensive experience in program or release management, technical program management, or delivery leadership, including ownership of a portfolio or program area.
* Proven ability to sequence and manage multiple interdependent releases or programs across teams and functions.
* Strong prioritization and decision judgment; comfortable owning sequencing and go / no-go calls under pressure.
* Excellent orchestration, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; drives alignment and decisions without direct authority.
* Command of enterprise release management practice — stage gates, release calendars, CAB, dependency mapping, DORA-style metrics; comfortable across Product, Engineering, and partner functions.

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**

* Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
* Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
* Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About The African Think Tank**

The African Think Tank (TATT) is seeking a TATT Thrive Program Manager to lead the coordination and delivery of our online TATT Thrive Masterclasses. This is an opportunity for an organized, proactive program professional who can manage details, build relationships with speakers and participants, and help create learning experiences that serve the African Diaspora.

**About TATT Thrive**

TATT Thrive connects people with practical learning and development opportunities across four areas: financial education, career development, entrepreneurship, and parenting and education. Through online masterclasses, we aim to make relevant knowledge accessible, encourage meaningful participation, and create opportunities for continued engagement with the TATT community.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Head of Programs & Impact, the TATT Thrive Program Manager will oversee the planning and coordination of the 2027 Masterclass series, with 11 online sessions scheduled from February through December.

You will help shape the annual program calendar, recruit and coordinate speakers, manage event logistics, collaborate on promotion, and ensure each session has a clear process for participant engagement and follow-up. You will also work with the communications and learning teams to track participation, gather feedback, and strengthen the program over time.

This role is about more than hosting online events. It is about creating a consistent, high-quality learning experience and helping TATT understand how Thrive can introduce new people to the organization and encourage deeper involvement in its community.

**Role Details**

**Position**: TATT Thrive Program Manager  
**Organization**: The African Think Tank (TATT)  
**Type**: Volunteer role  
**Location**: Remote  
**Reports to**: Head of Programs & Impact

**Key Responsibilities**

* Program planning and coordination
* Develop and maintain the annual Masterclass calendar, including topics, dates, formats, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate planning and execution for monthly sessions from speaker preparation through post-event follow-up.
* Establish clear workflows, checklists, and standard operating procedures to support reliable delivery.

**Speaker and facilitator engagement**

* Identify and coordinate potential speakers, drawing on relevant professional networks and TATT’s existing speaker community.
* Manage speaker communications, scheduling, preparation, and required agreements.
* Work with the Head of Learning & Organizational Development to help speakers understand TATT’s facilitation expectations and learning standards.
* Coordinate speaker honoraria approvals with the appropriate finance lead before commitments are finalized.

**Event operations and digital delivery**

* Manage registration, participant communications, reminders, virtual session logistics, and hosting arrangements.
* Coordinate recording, upload sessions to the TATT-U learning library, and ensure recordings are available within seven days after each session.
* Test the full event process in advance and prepare speakers and internal teams for smooth delivery.

**Marketing and audience engagement**

* Work with the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to develop and implement a promotion calendar for upcoming Masterclasses.
* Support outreach to both TATT members and non-members, making sessions accessible to prospective members.
* Coordinate appropriate opportunities to introduce participants to TATT membership and other ways to stay engaged.

**Monitoring, evaluation, and improvement**

* Coordinate participant surveys and follow-up activities, working with the Head of Programs & Impact.
* Track registrations, attendance, first-time contacts, member and non-member participation, and subsequent membership conversion in collaboration with the CMO.
* Summarize feedback and participation data to identify improvements for future sessions.
* Maintain accurate program records and share regular progress updates with relevant team members.

**Cross-functional collaboration**

* Work closely with the TATT Thrive Committee, Head of Programs & Impact, CMO, Head of Learning & Organizational Development, and other relevant team members.
* Help ensure the Masterclass series supports TATT’s broader program and community engagement priorities.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In the first 90 days, the successful candidate will be expected to**:

* Develop a proposed 2027 Masterclass calendar and end-to-end delivery process for approval.
* Confirm speakers for the first three sessions, with registration and operational workflows in place.
* Establish participation and follow-up tracking in collaboration with the CMO.
* Test the complete Masterclass process, from registration through recording and survey follow-up.
* Secure speakers through July 2027 and prepare the February session for delivery.
* As the series progresses, success will include consistent, well-organized sessions; meaningful participant feedback; timely publication of recordings; and clear reporting on audience engagement and new connections with TATT.
* The program will also aim for a participant survey response rate of at least 50% for the February session.

**Why Join TATT?**

This is an opportunity to help build a learning program with the potential to connect people to practical knowledge, experienced voices, and a wider community of support. You’ll work with a committed team and contribute directly to the development of a program designed to help individuals learn, connect, and thrive.

Pay: $1.00 - $2.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

**Position Title:** REACH Project Manager

**Reports to:** Cancer Programs Director

**Salary Range:** $75,000 - $80,000 Annually DOQ

**Classification:** Full-time, Exempt

**Location:** Remote with occasional travel (approximately 15-20%)

**To Apply:** A résumé and a cover letter detailing your interest in the position and relevant experience are required. Applications submitted without will be automatically rejected.

**About AICAF**

The American Indian Cancer Foundation (AICAF), a national nonprofit, is committed to supporting American Indian and Alaska Native (Ai/AN) cancer patients, communities, tribal leaders, and healthcare providers with the knowledge and resources to improve cancer prevention, early detection, treatment, and survivorship outcomes across Indian Country. By educating and empowering, we can collectively work towards a cancer-free future for our people and future generations.

P**osition Summary**

The REACH Project Manager position involves active involvement in the Racial and Ethnic Approaches to Community Health (REACH) project, a nationwide initiative overseen by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). AICAF was one of fifty organizations to receive this funding aimed at improving health, preventing chronic diseases, and reducing health disparities among racial and ethnic populations with the highest risk, or burden, of chronic disease.

The REACH Project Manager will be responsible for oversight and implementation of the (REACH) project under the supervision of the Cancer Programs Manager. In this role, the AICAF team will lean into your expertise, which will include, but is not limited to: 1) coalition building and facilitation, community engagement, collaboration, and buy-in support with various entities, such as tribal, local, state, and national organizations; 2) the development and dissemination of culturally tailored materials and messaging; 3) knowledge of traditional tobacco practices; 4) the ability to implement activities and strategies to support positive outcomes; and 5) familiarity and capacity to understand and implement policy, systems, and environmental changes related to healthy eating, tobacco, well-being, and promotion of physical activity.

Please Note: while the primary focus of this role involves this ongoing REACH project, you may be asked to contribute to other tasks or projects, temporarily or permanently, as determined by organizational needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and report program activities; manage program budget; and participate in routine CDC meetings, annual performance reporting, and other required program reports to ensure compliance with funding and program requirements.
* Work with the leadership team on the implementation of organizational strategies, policies, and practices.

jobs.description:
Project Coordinator – Commercial Solar & Energy Storage

**Coldwell Solar | Rocklin, CA | Full-Time**

Big Energy. Bigger Projects. Zero Interest in Boring Work.

Some people see a set of drawings, a spreadsheet full of numbers, and a complicated electrical system.

You see an opportunity waiting to become a project.

At **Coldwell Solar**, we're looking for a **Project Coordinator** who knows that successful solar projects don't start when construction begins. They start long before the first crew arrives, with smart planning, accurate estimating, technical know-how, and someone who can connect all the moving pieces.

We're talking commercial and industrial solar installations, battery energy storage systems, equipment replacements, and repower projects. The kind of work that requires equal parts analytical thinking, construction knowledge, and the ability to keep a dozen plates spinning without dropping the important ones.

If you love figuring out how things work, what they'll cost, and what it will take to make them happen, we should talk.

Here's Where You Come In

**Crunch the Numbers. Catch the Problems.**

* Build accurate estimates, from early concepts to detailed project pricing.
* Develop material takeoffs, labor budgets, and subcontractor cost comparisons.
* Evaluate vendor proposals, identify scope gaps, and flag financial risks before they become expensive surprises.
* Keep estimating tools, templates, and historical cost information organized and up to date.

**Help Turn Opportunities Into Actual Projects.**

* Partner with Sales to evaluate commercial solar and energy storage opportunities.
* Provide technical input, preliminary pricing, and support for customer proposals.
* Participate in customer meetings and site visits to gather the information needed to evaluate potential projects.
* Review drawings, utility bills, equipment specifications, and site conditions.
* Help determine whether an opportunity makes technical and financial sense before it moves forward.

**Give Existing Solar Systems a Second Act.**

Not every solar project starts from scratch. Sometimes the smartest solution is making an existing system better.

* Take ownership of solar repower and equipment-replacement opportunities.
* Evaluate existing modules, inverters, and electrical infrastructure.
* Work with Engineering and Procurement to identify compatible equipment and practical solutions.
* Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, and permitting and interconnection strategies.
* Move repower opportunities from evaluation through approved scope and project handoff.

**Keep the Moving Parts Moving.**

* Coordinate site evaluations, preliminary engineering, surveys, geotechnical work, and permitting feasibility.
* Track development schedules, milestones, deliverables, and outstanding decisions.
* Identify long-lead equipment and early procurement needs.
* Work with internal teams, consultants, vendors, and subcontractors to keep opportunities progressing.
* Spot potential roadblocks early and help develop solutions before they derail a project.

**Set the Construction Team Up to Win.**

Your finish line is the signed contract or limited Notice to Proceed (NTP). That's when the Project Manager and Assistant Project Manager take the reins.

* Prepare organized, accurate handoff packages with the budgets, schedules, scopes, and technical details the team needs.
* Communicate open items, assumptions, and risks clearly.
* Ensure the project team isn't left playing detective to figure out what was promised, priced, or planned.
* Help improve estimating, development, and handoff processes along the way.

What You'll Bring to the Table

**The Must-Haves:**

* 3+ years of experience in commercial solar, electrical construction, estimating, project coordination, or preconstruction.
* Working knowledge of commercial photovoltaic (PV) systems, electrical equipment, and construction practices.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, single-line diagrams, and equipment specifications.
* Experience preparing estimates, budgets, and scopes of work.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence collaborating across departments.
* Proficiency in Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* The ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through.

**The Nice-to-Haves:**

* Commercial solar EPC and battery energy storage experience.
* Experience evaluating solar repowers and inverter replacements.
* Familiarity with California permitting, interconnection processes, and electrical codes, including PG&E and SCE requirements.
* Experience with Procore, Microsoft Project, or SharePoint.
* Background in procurement, vendor negotiations, or subcontractor coordination.

You're Probably Our Person If...

* You can look at a project and see the potential problems before anyone else notices them.
* You understand that a great estimate is more than a number on a spreadsheet.
* You enjoy the technical side of construction but also know how to communicate with actual humans.
* You don't panic when priorities shift or a project throws you a curveball.
* You're organized enough to manage the details but strategic enough to see the big picture.
* You take pride in handing off a project that's ready to go — not one held together with assumptions and crossed fingers.
* You believe problems are meant to be solved, not simply forwarded in an email.

What Does Success Look Like?

Pretty simple: Projects move forward because you did your homework.

Your estimates are accurate. Your development milestones stay on track. Your risks are identified early. Your repower opportunities are properly evaluated. And when a project transitions to construction, the PM team has what it needs to hit the ground running.

jobs.description:
**Who You Are:**
================

Do you love talking to people and have a passion for travel and being active outdoors? Do you have a deep-rooted desire to help others and prepare them for a positive active travel experience of their own? As a full-time Operations Coordinator at Backroads’ Croatia Hub, you are responsible for coordinating ground **warehouse operations and execution of the hub’s yearly operational cycle**.

Acting as the bridge between planning and execution, you ensure that van fleet, equipment, spaces, and workflows are always organized, functional, and ready to support field operations.  
  
This role plays a central part in ensuring that the hub operates efficiently through **Van Fleet Prep (season start)**, **Unit Loads (season start)** and **End-of-Season Maintenance – EOSM (season end)**.  
  
You’ll also play a key role in fostering cross-hub collaboration during loads to align shared inventory and transport logistics. If you thrive on solving operational puzzles, have a hands-on approach, love active travel culture, and enjoy working in a collaborative international environment, we’d love to meet you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Van Fleet**

* Coordinate the day-to-day management of the company van fleet to ensure vehicles are operational, safe, and trip-ready

* Schedule and track preventive maintenance, inspections, servicing, and repairs.
* Maintain accurate fleet records, including registrations, insurance, maintenance history, and compliance documentation.
* Ensure vehicle compliance with company safety standards and local regulatory requirements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance fleet reliability, efficiency, and guest experience.

* Support loading operations and ensure execution aligns with planning

* Ensure daily functionality of all hub spaces
* Maintain clean, safe, and functional work environments
* Perform hands-on fixes and small repairs using basic tools
* Identify opportunities to improve facility usability and efficiency
* Coordinate small-scale facility improvements and external contractors

**Team Leadership**

* Assist to lead and to coordinate staff on temporary assignments
* Provide structure, guidance, and support to seasonal staff
* Ensure consistency and quality of execution across operations
* Promote a collaborative and structured working environment

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Work closely with Operations Lead

**Qualifications**

* **Operations Experience:** 2+ years in warehouse, logistics, facility, or operational roles
* **Hands-On Approach:** Comfortable with physical work and basic repairs
* **Problem Solving:** Practical, proactive, and solution-oriented
* **Organization:** Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
* **Driving Skills:** Valid driver’s license and confidence driving vans and trailers
* **Technical Skills:** Comfortable with Excel, Using BR OPS systems (OPS Dashboard, Ascent, Command Centre) AI skills welcomed
* **Communication:** Fluent English, Croatian preferred
* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to lift up to 50 lbs

Founded in 1979, Backroads is the world’s leading guest-focused travel company, offering luxury Biking, Hiking & Walking, and Multi-Adventure Trips for active people of all ages and experience levels. But we’re more than a travel company —we’re pioneers in crafting extraordinary experiences that bring people closer to the world and each other. We blend innovation, precision, and an unrelenting drive for excellence, drawing strength from our roots as a long-standing, family-run, global company. We are dynamic, resilient and invest deeply in our people and our guests. We set the benchmark in active travel and raise it every year.

jobs.title: Manager, Independent Customer Success
jobs.description:
### **About the role:**

PetDesk is looking for a Manager, Independent Customer Success to lead the day-to-day execution of our Independent Customer Success team. The team serves clinics through two engagement models: a named CSM model for clinics that need a dedicated partner, and a pooled, digital-first model that supports clinics at scale.

The Director of Customer Success owns the frameworks and org-level strategy. This manager owns the execution layer: turning those frameworks into consistent team practice, coaching CSMs to measurable outcomes, and making sure no customer, escalation or save opportunity falls through the cracks.

Our customers are veterinary practices, not SaaS buyers, so the right approach often looks different from a traditional CS playbook. You'll help the team meet clinics where they are, whether that's a named CSM partnership or a scaled pooled experience.

### **Apply if you're excited to:**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of 7 CSMs across the named and pooled models through regular 1:1s, call and play reviews, performance feedback, goal setting and development plans
* Hire, onboard and ramp new CSMs against clear 3, 6 and 12-month outcomes, and review performance profiles at least quarterly
* Run both CS models day to day, making sure accounts sit in the right model and segment and move between models and CSMs with clean handoffs
* Balance named books equitably across CSMs based on account complexity, volume and capacity, and plan PTO coverage so response-time targets hold
* Monitor pooled queue health daily, including prioritization, response times, aging accounts and escalations, so nothing falls through the cracks
* Make sure named CSMs deliver Success Plans and Business Reviews to standard, and pooled CSMs run ChurnZero plays and one-to-many programs (webinars, virtual office hours) consistently
* Drive the Adoption milestone so new clinics graduate on time, and act on Launch CSAT, BR CSAT and NPS signals
* Own the team's churn and downgrade results, with visibility into account health and churn risk and mitigation plans built before issues escalate
* Serve as the team's escalation point, coaching CSMs through difficult customer situations and partnering with Support, Product and Implementation to resolve them
* Coach the team to identify expansion opportunities and hand qualified opportunities to Sales
* Report weekly to the Director, Customer Success on team activity, churn and downgrades, saves, loss opp pipeline, queue health, adoption and NRR
* Drive consistent use of ChurnZero and Salesforce, and keep data accurate so reporting can be trusted
* Continuously evaluate and improve plays, workflows and team practices based on customer and performance data, and surface recommendations to the Director
* Travel up to 25% for customer onsites, industry events and team gatherings

### **About you:**

* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, with 2+ years managing or formally leading a team
* Experience leading both high-touch (named book) and scaled or digital (pooled, one-to-many) Customer Success models
* Proven record of reducing churn and downgrades, running save plays, and improving retention and NRR
* Strong ability to coach to performance, set clear expectations and hold team members accountable to measurable outcomes while keeping trust high
* Experience hiring, onboarding and ramping Customer Success team members
* Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to use health scores, usage data and dashboards to prioritize team activity and spot risk early
* Highly organized and process-minded, able to manage people, priorities and volume through systems and consistent operating rhythms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting team performance and metrics to leadership
* Comfortable facilitating group settings, including webinars, virtual office hours and Business Reviews
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Support, Implementation, Product and Sales
* ChurnZero or comparable Customer Success platform experience required
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience required; Guru or a similar knowledge base is a plus
* Able to travel up to 25%
* Veterinary industry experience is a plus

### **What success looks like:**

* The team meets or exceeds its targets for churn, downgrades, retention and NRR. Targets are set with the Director, Customer Success and tracked as part of this role's performance goals
* Every cancellation and downgrade notice becomes a loss opp, and the team's save rate is measured against target and improves over time
* On-time Adoption milestone completion is measured against target, and every new clinic has a Success Plan
* Launch CSAT and BR CSAT are measured against target and stay at or above it
* All 7 CSMs have clear expectations and consistent coaching, meet activity and Business Review targets, and new hires ramp on schedule
* The pooled queue is consistently covered, with no aging accounts or missed response-time targets going unnoticed
* Escalations are actively managed and are resolved, routed and documented promptly
* Weekly reporting gives leadership a clear, accurate view of performance, risk and saves, backed by clean Salesforce and ChurnZero data
* Expansion opportunities are consistently identified and handed off to Sales
* Plays, workflows and team practices are regularly evaluated and improved based on performance and customer data

### **Benefits & Perks:**

* Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80-90% covered by employer)
* Employer HSA contribution with HDHP
* 401(k) match up to 3.5%
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental & Vision coverage available
* Basic Life and AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Time Off & 12 Paid Annual Holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support & Subsidized Pet Insurance
* $250 Ann

**Customer Success Lead**  
**Recycled materials**  
**Location:** Remote — Europe

**About MineHub**
=================

At MineHub, we’re transforming how the world’s largest producers, traders, and consumers manage raw material supply chains. Our solutions combine critical B2B marketplace functionality (handling high-volume transactions for global supply chains) with intuitive B2C design, enabling customers to streamline logistics, reduce costs, and build more resilient, sustainable operations through real-time data integration and predictive analytics.  
Jules extends MineHub’s offering into the recycled materials industry. Scrap and secondary-materials traders, recyclers and brokers use Jules to run their business end to end: buying and selling; managing inventory across yards and stockpiles; container, bulk, and truck logistics; trade documentation; invoicing and payments; and price-risk management.

**The Role**
============

We're looking for a Customer Success Lead to own customer success for the Jules platform. You'll combine a strong understanding of commodity supply chains with the leadership to build and develop a small, high-performing CSM team. You'll personally own our most strategic accounts while setting the standards, processes, and priorities the rest of the team works to. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll be as comfortable running a go-live with a customer's operations team as you are coaching a CSM or making the case to Product for what our customers need next. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll collaborate across CS, Product, Engineering, Sales and leadership.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead, coach and develop the Jules CSM team: set clear expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and help hire as the team scales.
* Own the Jules customer portfolio's health, retention and expansion, and report on it to leadership with clear, commercially grounded metrics.
* Personally manage our most strategic and complex accounts, from implementation through to renewal and expansion.
* Build and continuously improve the team's playbooks: onboarding and go-live, data migration, health monitoring, QBRs, renewals and escalations.
* Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering: synthesise feedback across accounts, frame it in commercial and operational terms, and influence roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Sales on pre-sales scoping, handover and expansion opportunities, ensuring what we sell can be delivered and adopted. (This is not a quota-carrying role.)
* Work with your counterparts across MineHub to share best practice and align ways of working across the group's platforms.

**Experience & Skills**
=======================

* Experience in recycled materials, metals or wider commodities trade is a strong advantage. If you're coming from an adjacent background, you'll be keen to learn how recycled materials are sourced, graded, shipped and documented, and to pick up the industry's terminology quickly.
* Experience leading, mentoring or coaching others, formally or informally: you've raised the performance of the people around you and set a standard others follow.
* Leadership qualities we'll look for at interview: sound judgement under pressure, clear prioritisation, ownership, the ability to give direct and constructive feedback, and the credibility to lead both internally and in front of customers.
* A strong track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and software implementations, with measurable outcomes in adoption, retention or expansion.
* Strong professional English. French is a plus, as we work with a number of French-speaking customers.
* Comfortable with technical topics: data set-up, document workflows, data imports, integrations and reporting. You can get into the detail yourself and guide your team through it. SQL or BI tool experience is a plus.
* Commercially minded. You understand how our customers make money, from margins to logistics costs and price risk, and can tie platform value to their P&L.
* Process-oriented without being bureaucratic. You introduce structure that helps a small team scale, and you know when to keep things simple.
* You're a self-starter who embraces ambiguity and enjoys building something, not just running it.

**Why MineHub?**
================

* Help build the digital backbone of the circular economy, in an industry where secondary raw materials are becoming strategically critical.
* Join a mission-driven team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term thinking in everything from customer relationships to code.
* Be part of a fast-growing company that combines startup energy with partnerships across major industry players worldwide.
* Enjoy the freedom to lead initiatives, own your accounts, and shape how recycled materials businesses experience our platform.

As a growing technology company, D5 values innovation, user-centric product development, and close collaboration with its global customer base.

* **Governance, Security & Enterprise Readiness:** Advise on managed deployment, access, data/IP handling, AI policy, model/vendor evaluation, token/usage economics, collaboration and controlled rollout.

* **5+ years of experience** in Architecture, Engineering or Construction (AEC), BIM, design technology, visualization, VDC, technical consulting or closely related work.

**Internal Coordination & Feedback**

* Act as a liaison between employers and internal teams including Business & Sales Development, Member Services, Operations, and Marketing.

* Contribute to team discussions around account strategy, employer engagement, and growth opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in account management, client services, customer success, or a similar role.

PCI Federal Services is seeking an **IT Support Supervisor** to lead day-to-day end-user technology support while remaining a hands-on technical resource. This position supervises IT support personnel, manages workload and escalations, monitors service performance, develops team capabilities, and drives continuous improvement of the employee technology experience.

* Assign and balance daily ticket workload.
* Ensure adequate phone, remote-support and onsite coverage.
* Monitor aging tickets, unassigned tickets and breached service targets.
* Conduct regular team meetings and one-on-one coaching.
* Coordinate schedules, coverage and after-hours support.
* Review ticket documentation and customer communication.
* Identify training and development needs.

* Ticket backlog and aging

* Tickets Reopened

* Escalation volume and quality
* Customer communication
* Knowledge article creation and use
* Onboarding and offboarding completion
* Equipment deployment and recovery
* Security-procedure adherence

* **5+ years** of progressively responsible IT support, service desk, desktop support, or related experience.

* Demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical issues and serve as an escalation resource.

* Strong leadership, customer service, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Microsoft 365 administration/support.
* Experience with SysAid, ServiceNow, or another ITSM platform.
* Experience with PowerShell, automation, or workflow improvement.
* Experience using service metrics and trends to improve support operations.
* ITIL, Microsoft, CompTIA, or comparable certification.

**Education**

Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred. Relevant professional experience, military technical training, certifications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

This position may be based in Huntsville, Atmore, the Washington, DC metropolitan area, or remote. Periodic travel to PCI Federal locations may be required.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

LTD Global, LLC is a certified woman-owned consulting firm based in Pleasanton, California, serving clients in the U.S. and abroad since 2003. We provide HR, accounting, and SaaS integration services to private, nonprofit, and government organizations, and we are Alameda SLEB certified and an SBA 8(a) program participant. Our HR team partners with nonprofits across the Bay Area and nationwide. We help them hire well, stay compliant, and build strong workplaces so they can focus on their missions.  
Our clients do vital work, often with lean teams and limited budgets. We give them the HR expertise they need to hire well, stay compliant, and build healthy workplaces, so they can stay focused on their missions.

**Position Summary**
====================

We are seeking a client-focused HR Generalist to deliver hands-on HR support to a portfolio of nonprofit clients. You will manage full-cycle recruitment, employee relations, compliance, payroll, and day-to-day HR operations.  
This is a client-facing role. You will act as a trusted HR partner to executive directors, managers, and staff, often serving as the primary HR resource for organizations without an in-house HR team. The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, and comfortable supporting several clients at once.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Draft, review, and update employee handbooks, policies, and procedures.
* Advise on wage and hour issues, including exempt versus non-exempt classification, meal and rest breaks, and overtime.
