new_jobs.description:
**TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

  

Position Type: Temporary, Full-Time (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt  
Employment Period: January–June 2027  
Reports To: Schools Program Manager  
Location: In-person at SFUSD school sites and LYRIC’s Purple House, San Francisco  
Hourly Rate: $30.58/hour (non-negotiable per LYRIC’s equity-based pay model)  
Union Status: Union position (OPEIU Local 29)

ABOUT THE POSITION

LYRIC seeks a thoughtful and experienced Temporary Schools Program Coordinator to deliver school-based support groups for SFUSD students, creating affirming spaces for LGBTQQ+ youth to strengthen positive identity development, self-esteem, personal growth, and peer connection. Serving 120 youth annually, the program offers weekly groups exploring healthy relationships, self-confidence, identity, and navigating school and community systems. Each cohort includes 3–10 students, averaging 5 participants, with sessions lasting up to 60 minutes, typically held in high school Wellness Centers or school-based health centers. The coordinator also connects students with LYRIC’s Purple House programs and supports programming there during spring break and summer break dates within the January–June employment period.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Youth Development & Engagement: Build on young people’s strengths, center their voices and choices, and support their leadership, independence, and progress toward their goals.

* Equity & Inclusion: Create affirming environments for LGBTQQ+ youth across identities and backgrounds. Practice cultural humility, examine personal biases, and recognize how systemic barriers affect young people’s lives.

* Relationship Building & Collaboration: Build trust with youth, coworkers, and community partners. Coordinate services, share relevant information appropriately, and contribute to shared goals.

* Effective Communication: Listen actively, communicate clearly and respectfully, and address concerns directly and constructively. Adapt communication to different needs and situations.

* Emotional Awareness & Self-Management: Recognize how personal emotions and reactions affect others. Remain grounded during challenging interactions and respond with empathy, professionalism, and a trauma-informed approach.

* Critical Thinking & Sound Judgment: Assess situations, identify appropriate next steps, and recognize when to seek guidance. Respond to safety concerns within established protocols and the scope of the role.

* Professional Integrity & Accountability: Maintain appropriate boundaries and confidentiality, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for actions. Communicate barriers early and follow organizational policies.

* Program Delivery & Organization: Prepare and deliver purposeful services and activities, manage time and resources responsibly, and complete accurate, timely documentation and follow-up.

* Learning & Adaptability: Seek and apply feedback, build relevant skills, and adjust to changing youth and program needs. Use reflection and experience to improve practice.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Youth Development & Group Facilitation

* Facilitate weekly support groups promoting positive identity development, self-esteem, healthy relationships, personal growth, and peer connection.
* Center youth voices and choices, creating opportunities for leadership and meaningful participation.
* Prepare and adapt age-appropriate curriculum informed by positive youth development, harm reduction, and youth sexual health education.
* Create inclusive, affirming environments that reflect students’ identities and address barriers to participation.
* Provide individual check-ins and basic resource support while maintaining boundaries and supporting youth independence.
* Respond to challenging group dynamics with empathy, self-awareness, and appropriate de-escalation; seek support when needed.

School-to-Community Connections

* Connect students with programs, services, and opportunities at LYRIC’s Purple House.
* Coordinate introductions, referrals, and follow-up with colleagues to help students access services and maintain engagement.
* Support Purple House programming during spring break and summer break dates within the employment period.

Program Planning & Partnerships

* Plan weekly sessions of up to 45 minutes for cohorts of 3–10 students.
* Prepare materials in advance, manage responsibilities across school sites, and use time and resources responsibly.
* Build collaborative relationships with school staff, counselors, Wellness Center staff, and community partners.
* Coordinate schedules, meeting spaces, and student referrals; communicate expectations and changes clearly.
* Participate in student support meetings when appropriate, sharing information within confidentiality requirements and the scope of the role.
* Use student feedback and participation data to improve programming and contribute to the program’s annual goal of serving 120 youth.

Documentation, Accountability & Safety

* Maintain accurate, timely records of participation, activities, referrals, and outcomes in LYRIC’s data systems.
* Contribute to program reports and funder documentation.
* Protect confidential information and follow procedures for storing and sharing records.
* Recognize safety concerns, follow reporting and response protocols, and consult the Schools Program Manager when guidance is needed.
* Follow through on commitments and communicate barriers early.

Teamwork & Professional Growth

* Participate in supervision, team meetings, trainings, and organization-wide events.
* Collaborate across departments and contribute to shared responsibilities.
* Seek and apply feedback, reflect on personal assumptions and reactions, and take responsibility for improvement.
* Adapt to changing school and program needs while communicating about priorities and capacity.
* Support an organized transition of program information and outstanding follow-up at the end of the assignment.

YOU BRING

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**Global Account Operations Manager**

**San Mateo, CA / Hybrid**

Global Account Operations (GAO) is the central hub for third-party account management at Sony Interactive Entertainment. GAO works across the Global Account Management (GAM) organization, one of the largest partner account teams in the industry. It sets how the team operates: the programs, processes, governance and business rhythm that help account managers deliver for PlayStation and our partners around the world.

We are looking for a Global Account Operations Manager to report to the Head of Global Account Operations. You will lead strategic programs and projects across GAM, starting with a redesign of several core programs, and processes. The right person is a structured problem solver who can take complex processes involving many stakeholders and simplify them into scalable operating models with clear outcomes. You will work closely with GAM leaders and cross-functional partners in every region. You will also create executive-quality materials that shape decisions at the most senior levels of the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead strategic programs and projects for the GAM team through every stage: scoping, planning, delivery, measurement and continuous improvement.

* Drive the redesign of core GAM programs. Assess current processes, find the gaps, and build simpler, scalable solutions that improve outcomes for the team and our partners.

* Own and evolve key operating mechanisms, including executive partner engagements, new title launch tracking, and adoption of key PlayStation initiatives across third-party partners.

* Structure ambiguous problems, form hypotheses, and build clear, data-backed recommendations for senior leadership.

* Create polished, executive-ready presentations, briefings and updates that turn complex information into clear narratives, insights and decisions.

* Analyze data from multiple sources to track program performance, spot trends and risks, and inform priorities.

* Build and maintain dashboards, reporting standards and metrics that give leadership clear visibility into team-wide engagements and progress.

* Support the GAM Rhythm of Business, including account planning, joint business reviews, forecasting and annual planning cycles.

* Represent the GAM team across SIE, working cross-functionally with finance, legal and other internal teams to align on priorities, resolve issues and move partner initiatives forward.

* Manage timelines, dependencies and risks across multiple workstreams at once, and act early to keep programs on track.

* Look for ways to improve how the team works, its tools and its efficiency, including practical uses of AI and automation.

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy and operations, business operations, program management, or a related field.

* Proven ability to structure complex problems and turn them into clear, actionable recommendations.

* Exceptional executive communication skills, with a high bar for written materials, presentation design and storytelling.

* Strong analytical skills and comfort using data, dashboards and metrics to generate insights. Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel.

* A track record of building or redesigning processes so they become simpler, more scalable and measurably more effective.

* Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, with a high degree of ownership.

* Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior leaders and working with globally distributed teams.

* A solution-oriented builder mindset, intellectual curiosity, and eagerness to take on stretch challenges.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience at a management consulting firm, or in a strategy, business operations or program role at a leading technology or platform company.

* Experience working in or supporting partner-facing, account management or commercial organizations.

* Interest in gaming, media or entertainment.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Project Manager (Redwood City, CA)**

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager (PM I) leads the planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of business and technology initiatives that support organizational objectives. This role manages projects from initiation through implementation and closure, including a brief post-production stabilization period. Upon successful stabilization, ownership and ongoing support are transitioned to the designated business and technology support teams.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for project delivery and partners closely with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, operational partners, and leadership to coordinate activities, manage risks, track and resolve issues, ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and drive successful outcomes that align with business goals.

While the primary focus of this role is project leadership and delivery, the Project Manager is also expected to perform Business Analyst functions when project needs require. This includes facilitating requirements gathering, documenting business and functional requirements, analyzing business processes, supporting solution design discussions, validating business needs, and assisting with testing and implementation activities. The Project Manager serves as a bridge between business and technical teams to help ensure solutions meet business objectives and operational needs.

In addition to managing assigned projects, the Project Manager plays an active role in project portfolio demand and intake management. This includes reviewing incoming project requests, ensuring requests are properly documented and filed within the project intake system, validating completeness of submitted information, coordinating follow-up activities as needed, and maintaining visibility into the project demand pipeline.

**Essential Functions**  
Essential Functions
  
Project Implementation & Delivery
  
Lead approved and prioritized cross-functional business and technology projects from initiation through closure.
  
Ensure Vendor Management due diligence requirements have been completed by the project owner prior to project implementation.  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies in partnership with project sponsors and stakeholders.  
  
Develop and maintain risk registers, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation strategies, and contingency plans, to minimize organizational exposure and project risk.  
  
Develop project work plans, schedules, key milestones, and target dates; drive project execution and adjust plans as necessary to ensure successful delivery of committed outcomes.  
  
Effectively apply PMO methodologies and enforce project governance, implementation, and delivery standards.  
  
Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete, current, and maintained within approved repositories.  
  
Business Analysis & Solution Validation  
  
Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, vendors, and technical teams.  
  
Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.  
  
Analyze current-state and future-state business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.  
  
Validate proposed solutions with stakeholders and confirm business needs, requirements, and project objectives have been addressed.  
  
Testing, Implementation & Operational Readiness  
  
Coordinate testing activities, user acceptance testing, implementation planning, deployment readiness, and go-live activities.  
  
Partner with impacted business units to ensure operational procedures, departmental workflows, job aids, training materials, and supporting documentation are developed or updated to reflect new or modified processes, systems, controls, regulatory requirements, and operational changes introduced by the project.  
  
Ensure all tracked issues, defects, risks, and action items are resolved, mitigated, formally accepted, or appropriately documented prior to deployment.  
  
Confirm stakeholder expectations have been met and obtain final approval and signoff from impacted business owners and the appropriate Vice President(s) prior to production deployment.  
  
Facilitate a successful transition to operational ownership and support following implementation and stabilization.  
  
Portfolio Intake & Demand Management  
  
Support administration and management of the project portfolio demand and intake pipeline.  
  
Ensure project requests are appropriately documented, categorized, tracked, and routed through the intake process.  
  
Maintain accurate intake and portfolio records to support project prioritization, capacity planning, and portfolio reporting.  
  
Provide visibility into project demand, resource needs, and portfolio pipeline status to leadership.  
  
**Knowledge & Business Acumen**

**Financial & Operational Management**  

* Understand project budgeting, financial planning, and cost management principles.
* Understand cost-benefit analysis and business case development.
* Understand vendor contracts, project-related legal documents, and procurement processes.

**Technical Knowledge**  

* Understand software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and information technology concepts.
* Understand web-based, cloud, internet, and client-server architectures.
* Awareness of emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Proficiency with project management and business analysis tools, including Microsoft Project, OneNote, Visio, Jira, Microsoft Office Suite, MS Teams, and other tools.

  
**Analytical & Communication Skills**

* Ability to synthesize complex information from multiple stakeholders, business units, vendors, and technical team

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About DCL Logistics**

For over 40 years, DCL Logistics has powered the brands that shape how the world shops. We are a modern 3PL and a technology company at heart, trusted by high-growth, innovative names in consumer electronics, health and beauty, wellness, and connected devices. Our proprietary platforms (eFactory, SelectShip, and ReturnTrak) give our clients full command of their supply chain, and our ISO 9001:2015 certified facilities deliver the precision and quality their customers expect. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with a national network reaching 96% of the U.S. population on two-day ground, we help ambitious brands scale without limits.

**Why DCL**

We are more than a fulfillment company. We are a team of people who make it happen. Our culture is built on four core values that show up in everything we do: Make It Happen, Be Resourceful, Deliver Operational Excellence, and We Care. Here, your work is visible, your ideas matter, and your impact is real from day one. We move fast, we hold ourselves to the highest standard, and we take care of our people. When you join DCL, you don't just join an organization. You join a family.

**Location Requirements:**

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must currently reside within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the following locations: Louisville, KY; York, PA; the San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Perris, CA; Ontario, CA; or the greater Southern California area.

**About the Role**

The Project Manager (PM) will lead internal initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, and performance across our fulfillment network. This role is focused on both **operational execution** and **IT project delivery**—driving cross-functional initiatives, implementing systems, and standardizing processes that support our warehouse operations and technology platforms. The Project Manager will partner with stakeholders across operations, IT, engineering, customer service and leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact.

This role reports directly to the Company President.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage cross-functional projects end-to-end: scope, timeline, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.
* Serve as the central point of coordination between IT, Operations, Accounting, and other functional teams, translating each group's priorities and constraints into a shared project plan.
* Run regular status meetings, steering committee updates, and stakeholder check-ins; maintain clear, consistent project documentation (charters, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify and resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, conflicting priorities, and resource contention before they become blockers.
* Establish and improve lightweight project management standards, templates, and governance so future cross-functional work doesn't have to start from scratch.
* Track project health (scope, schedule, budget, risk) and escalate proactively when a project is at risk.
* Partner with functional managers to ensure resources are allocated appropriately without disrupting day-to-day departmental operations.
* Support post-project reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* **PMP Certified with 3–6 years o**f project management experience in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or IT project delivery.
* Strong understanding of fulfillment and warehouse operations, as well as related technology systems.
* Experience leading IT projects involving WMS, OMS, ERP, or ecommerce integrations.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in project management tools (Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or equivalent).
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or ITIL certification a plus.

Releady is partnering with a leading healthcare technology company to hire a Technical Program Manager, Consultant. Launched in 2025 as part of a major nonprofit health plan’s corporate restructuring, this organization builds AI-powered data, engagement, and operations technology for nonprofit and community health plans nationwide.

This program is the team’s most urgent priority, and it needs a program manager who brings structure, momentum, and accountability to a complex, multi-stakeholder effort. You will work directly with senior leaders across both organizations, hold firm on scope and timelines, and keep deliverables on schedule. This role's success depends on confident communication, sound judgment, and a relentless focus on delivery.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
One Hat One Hand is a design and fabrication company specializing in architectural placemaking, large-scale public art, product prototyping and experiential design.

Our team of designers, fabricators, artists, welders & technologists work with artisans and builders to create large-scale placemaking features, art fabrication and specialty installations. We collaborate with our clients every step of the way, taking pride in the talents and creative skills of our team. We work hard to produce seemingly impossible installations through thoughtful design, hands-on fabrication, and technology integration.

Our website offers a deeper dive into our world, our work, our people and our process. Please visit us at www.onehatonehand.com

**PROJECT MANAGER | ONE HAT ONE HAND**

One Hat One Hand is seeking a qualified Project Manager with experience in interior design, architecture, event production, industrial design, custom fabrication, and/or construction. The role is primarily a project management position but also requires a strong design sensibility, the ability to design and 3D model in Rhino, and the ability to read and redline architectural drawing sets. The right candidate is detail-oriented, excited by teamwork, and has a background in project management and design for fabrication.

**Overview**

The Project Manager is responsible for successfully overseeing and delivering all contracted scope for a given project, incorporating aspects of account management, production management, project management, and design. This role ensures clear communication of the project schedule and deliverables among clients, designers, and the production team.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Primary contact for Clients, Consultants, Account Managers, and Project Stakeholders.
* Oversee the development of design concepts, 3D visualizations, and presentation decks for client meetings
* Collaborate with designers and the internal Production Department for prototyping strategies, build drawings, production schedules, and install and maintenance plans
* Manage the production of technical documentation for coordination with contractors, structural engineering, MEP engineering, and permitting
* Coordinate and conduct meetings with project stakeholders; create agendas, take detailed notes, and distribute follow-up materials
* Maintain communication regarding scope, schedule, and budget with all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with subcontractors and client on problem solving, documenting changes, and foreseeing change orders or scope creep with account managers
* Project based time management of hours allocated per task, phase, and department
* Coordinate fabrication schedules within and between projects
* Track and manage project finances; issue contracts, budget revisions, and invoices; source, order materials, and coordinate deliveries
* Prepare and present intermediate and final job reports
* Compile final documentation of project (photos, designs, descriptions) in collaboration with the marketing department
* Work with Design Studio Manager to ensure project asset are being organized and archived for easy cross department navigation
* Create and maintain tools to facilitate cross functional collaboration
* Collaborating with account managers and finance on creating, maintaining, and tracking internal and external budgets
* Ensuring that projects are created with reasonable and profitable budgets.
* Performing Regular 360 project reviews to ensure, budget is reflective of materials, labor, and design. That assets are organized, and departments are aware of the project timeline
* Find opportunities to add value to clients and exceed client expectations to ensure client retention and satisfaction for future projects

  

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* Project management, client management, schedule creation and management, and construction administration
* Highly creative with strong critical thinking skills
* Passion for experiential storytelling and inclusive team management
* Clear and concise written and spoken communication skills
* Detail-oriented with professional meeting etiquette and management skills; agenda creation, concise note taking, and punctuality
* Knowledge of materials, fabrication techniques and technologies, and rapid prototyping including CNC, laser cutting, waterjet, 3D printing
* Knowledge of production, construction, engineering, and architectural terminology
* Highly adaptable in transferring skills and knowledge to new jobs that may require flexibility in systems previously developed or used
* Strong design sensibility, storyboarding, presentation design, graphic design, sketching, drawing markup
* 3D modeling, rendering. MUST be able to use RHINO and be able to design at a mid level.
* Programs: Adobe CS, Bluebeam, Asana, Instagantt or other Gantt charts, GSuite, Procore, Rhino

  

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $95,000 to $105,000 per year, depending on experience. This role is hybrid but the ability to attend meetings at our campus headquarters and client job sites as needed is required.

Please do not reach out via email, instead follow the below link to be considered for this position. Please include a resume and cover letter to apply. We look forward to reviewing your application.

This role helps shape and execute both regional and local strategies, translating vision into practical initiatives that strengthen frontline engagement, team performance, and organizational culture.

Ensures the alignment, buy-in, engagement, and support of diverse program stakeholders. Reviews vendor performance levels, ensures service level agreements are met, and participates in contract negotiations with vendors.

* Promotes learning in others by communicating information and providing advice to drive projects forward; builds relationships with cross-functional stakeholders. Listens, responds to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides actionable feedback to others, including upward feedback to leadership and mentors junior team members. Practices self-leadership; creates and executes plans to capitalize on strengths and improve opportunity areas; influences team members within assigned team or unit. Adapts to competing demands and new responsibilities; adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback. Models team collaboration within and across teams.

Partners internally and externally to make effective business decisions; determines and carries out processes and methodologies; solves complex problems; escalates high-priority issues or risks, as appropriate; monitors progress and results. Develops work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines; coordinates and delegates resources to accomplish organizational goals. Recognizes and capitalizes on improvement opportunities; evaluates recommendations made; influences the completion of project tasks by others.
* Manages large-scale programs or components with multiple workstreams and strategic business goals across departments, functions, or regions with responsibility and accountability for achieving program outcomes from initiation to close-out in an extended or open ended time frame. new_jobs.title: Manager, Product Management - Global Program Enablement
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Team Summary:

The Global Consumer Card Products group manages the deployment and optimization of Visa’s core products base consisting of Credit, Debit and Prepaid payments solutions globally. The team is also responsible for the development and deployment of innovation across this product suite such as stablecoin and cross-border issuance programs. To do this, we work in partnership with Visa clients and key internal and external stakeholders across the globe. We are also the team responsible for leading the transition of conventional card-based solutions onto digital form factors, ensuring Visa payments solutions remain the market-leading way for consumers to spend their money and manage their payments across Visa’s global regions.

What the Manager, Product Management does at Visa:

Visa is seeking a Manager, Product Management to support the evolution and operational excellence of Visa's Program Enrollment ecosystem supporting Stablecoin, Crypto, and Cross-Border Issuance programs. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, risk management, operations, compliance, and client enablement. The successful candidate will own the end-to-end product experience for program assessment & onboarding processes, ensuring that innovative payment solutions can scale globally while maintaining alignment with Visa rules, AML requirements, regulatory expectations, and operational standards. The role will focus on evaluating complex program structures, driving program modernization initiatives, identifying process improvement opportunities, and partnering across Product, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Regional teams, and external clients to accelerate program approvals and launches.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Review & Governance:

* Lead reviews of Program Enrollments for Stablecoin, Crypto, and Cross-Border Issuance programs.
* Assess program structures, funding models, operating models, customer journeys, and partner ecosystems.
* Evaluate program documentation including program descriptions and value propositions; transaction flows and flow-of-funds diagrams; AML, sanctions, KYC, and transaction monitoring frameworks; third-party agent and partner relationships; and cross-border issuance structures and country expansion plans

Product & Process Innovation:

* Help define and execute the product roadmap for program modernization and operational transformation initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to simplify client onboarding, leveraging AI to improve submission quality, and reduce review cycle times.
* Develop scalable review frameworks, approval workflows, and automation opportunities.
* Drive improvements to submission tools, operational processes, client guidance, and review methodologies.
* Analyze review data and operational metrics to identify bottlenecks and improve overall program throughput.

Stakeholder Management:

* Serve as a key point of coordination between Product, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Regional Product, Account Executives, and Operations teams.
* Develop executive-level communications, reporting, and recommendations.
* Create client-facing guidance, best practices, and educational materials to improve submission quality and client experience.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment on strategic priorities and operational improvements.

Why this is important to Visa:

This role is critical to Visa's ability to scale next-generation payment solutions globally.

As Stablecoin, Crypto, and Cross-Border Issuance programs continue to grow, Visa must balance innovation with strong governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance. The Manager, Product Management will help ensure that clients can bring new payment products to market efficiently while maintaining the integrity of Visa's network and compliance standards.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or related field.
* 5+ years’ experience in product management, payments, credit products, or financial services.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit products, payment technology, and emerging fintech solutions. Experience with Stablecoin products preferred.
* Technical fluency and ability to translate complex requirements into actionable product features.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a matrixed, global organization with cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical skills and business acumen, with experience in performance tracking and reporting.
* Excellent communication skills, with ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Proficiency in using AI tools and AI-enabled workflows to analyze information, improve productivity, and support product and process decision-making.

**About Bill Wilson Center:**

Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. Bill Wilson Center has been providing services to runaway and homeless youth since 1973. Join us and become a difference maker at Bill Wilson Center!

**Job Summary:**

The Program Manager oversees the planning, organization and service delivery of the Direct Cash Program. The Program Manager supervises the case management staff to ensure the delivery of high quality of service, client centered care and monitor program outcomes. The Program Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the program, establishing a supportive and welcoming atmosphere for all program participants homeless street youth receiving services by performing the following duties and responsibilities within the Vision, Mission and Agency Values of BWC

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Ensure the team accurately and promptly logs all client case notes and service transactions interactions in Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) or internal databases.
* Oversee the program's operational budget, tracking expenses related to client assistance and stipends.
* Creation of monthly check requests and tracking of financial services
* Manage the requisition and hiring process for staff
* Oversee the team’s daily assignments, ensuring equitable distribution of workload and troubleshooting complex, high-barrier participant cases.
* Monitor front-line staff to ensure they are meeting performance standards. Routinely audit staff contact logs, client follow-ups, and daily task completion.
* Ensure all staff maintain up-to-date client records, statistical data, and required documentation within **HMIS** and **AWARDS** database systems, strictly adhering to agency and contractor timelines and confidentiality policies.
* Review and analyze program data, trends, and participant outcomes. Prepare and submit comprehensive reports required for government contracts, private grants, and internal agency dashboards.
* Actively participate in the agency’s Program Quality Improvement (PQI) processes to continuously elevate service delivery standards.
* Assist Director in ensuring all daily operations meet strict programmatic, legal, and fiscal grant requirements.
* Conduct regular OKR check-ins with staff, identifying operational bottlenecks early and pivoting team strategies to ensure Key Results are met on time.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience:**

* Experience working with people including those that have intersected with the foster care or probation systems and/or those that have experienced homelessness, or personal experience in the above.
* Associate’s Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work, Human Services, Psychology, Communications, or related field desired but not a requirement

* Record information

* Fast paced

* Flexible Spending Plans for Medical, Dependent Care, Parking and Transit

We are seeking an Events Program Manager to own event sales, strategy, and execution for the Vehicle Accessories and Merchandise team. You will develop and scale the event strategy, plan product assortment for internal and external Tesla events, and drive execution and planning through post event analysis. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role requiring event strategy, assortment, stakeholder management, and data-driven decision making in a fast-paced environment. Based in Los Angeles or the Bay Area.

  
**What You'll Do**

* Develop, execute, and scale the event strategy for merchandise and accessories across internal and external Tesla events
* Plan the product assortments and merchandise displays for every event including hero products, regional relevance, inventory quantities, inventory allocation, limited-edition launches, and cross-functional collaborations
* Own logistics from planning through execution, including timelines, shipping, fixtures, event space, staffing, on-site inventory management, and inventory reconciliation
* Lead on- site at event operations, including merchandising, sales execution, replenishment, and inventory control; establish point-of-sale processes, maintain product availability, train event staff, and reconcile inventory and revenue following each event

new_jobs.title: Equity Compensation Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox is seeking an Equity Compensation Program Manager reporting to the Manager of Executive & Equity Compensation. In this hybrid role based in our San Mateo headquarters, you will take a strong quantitative and analytical stance on building and optimizing our equity operating system. Joining our Total Rewards team, you will be instrumental in executing our equity compensation programs while ensuring Roblox's offerings are competitive, meaningful, and aligned with business priorities. If you are someone who enjoys working with large datasets, modeling complex financial scenarios, and building innovative equity strategies, this job is for you.

**You Will:**

* Play a key role in managing and scaling our equity compensation programs, including monthly new hire grant preparation, equity budgeting, burn rate tracking, and dilution modeling.
* Support the research, ongoing development, and maintenance of equity programs and policies to ensure they remain highly competitive, compliant, and aligned with market trends.
* Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis to see beyond the numbers; build intelligence through reporting to inform, influence, and execute critical business decisions.
* Develop complex compensation models, statistical analyses, and automated dashboards to monitor equity metrics, ensuring the highest level of data integrity and validity.
* Develop clear, impactful communication materials to educate participants and business leaders on new equity programs, structural changes, and the value of their equity.
* Collaborate deeply with internal partners (Finance, Legal, Accounting, Stock Admin) and external vendors to manage complex equity inquiries and escalations.
* Work in a culture of continuous analytics, consistently monitoring current programs to identify areas for workflow automation and strategic improvement.

**You Have:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with at least 5 years of corporate and/or consulting compensation-related experience, ideally within the technology sector or high-growth public companies.
* Deep understanding of the design, mechanics, and structure of public company equity plans (e.g., RSUs, PSUs, Stock Options, new hire equity design, and annual refresh programs).
* Direct, hands-on experience managing equity budgeting, forecasting, run-rate, and dilution modeling.
* Exceptional analytical skills with expert-level proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; ability to perform complex scenario modeling and handle massive datasets.
* Demonstrated experience effectively translating complex equity concepts and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite executives.
* A highly detail-driven mindset with an emphasis on zero-defect accuracy, speed of execution, and the ability to connect granular data to the broader strategic picture.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

**Why Harvey**
==============

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

**Role Overview**
=================

Harvey is hiring a Customer Success Leader to manage and develop a team of experienced CSMs supporting our strategic law firm accounts. These partnerships span offices, practice groups and regions, requiring an understanding of how firms operate, make decisions and deliver value to their clients.

You will help the team turn firm priorities into sustained adoption, measurable improvements in legal work and lasting partnerships. Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, Majors, you will also help shape how we support strategic law firm accounts as Harvey evolves.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Lead and develop the team.** Coach CSMs on account strategy, stakeholder relationships and prioritization while managing performance, supporting career development and hiring. Set practical standards for success planning, business reviews and renewal preparation.
* **Own portfolio outcomes.** Be accountable for retention, net revenue retention and adoption across your team’s accounts. Partner with Sales on renewal strategy, forecasting and expansion opportunities, using account data and customer feedback to address risks early.
* **Drive measurable customer value.** Guide the team in identifying high-impact use cases across practice groups, defining success measures and helping lawyers embed Harvey into their work. Ensure account plans connect implementation and adoption to improvements in efficiency, work quality and client service.
* **Lead executive engagement and customer escalations.** Meet directly with senior firm stakeholders, including Partners and knowledge and innovation leaders, to review progress, align on priorities and address concerns. Step in when urgent issues arise, coordinating Harvey’s response and ensuring clear communication, ownership and follow-through.
* **Align teams around customer priorities.** Bring together Sales, Legal Engineering, Product, Engineering and Security to support account plans. Clarify ownership, coordinate resources and work with functional leaders to resolve competing priorities.
* **Influence product direction.** Bring evidence from strategic law firm accounts to Product and go-to-market leadership. Identify recurring adoption barriers, surface unmet needs and help prioritize improvements with broad customer impact.

**What You Have**
=================

* 10+ years of experience in customer success, account management, consulting or professional services, including at least 4 years directly managing CSMs or account teams serving large enterprises.
* A track record of delivering retention and expansion outcomes across complex enterprise accounts, including leading renewal and growth strategies in partnership with Sales.
* Experience building strong teams through coaching, clear expectations and thoughtful performance management.
* The ability to earn trust with senior stakeholders, lead difficult customer conversations and influence decisions across functions without direct authority.
* Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to interpret adoption data, assess account risk and connect customer outcomes to commercial decisions.
* Experience helping organizations adopt new technology and change established ways of working, with an understanding of AI’s opportunities and limitations. Experience serving law firms and navigating their partnership structures, practice-group needs and technology adoption is strongly preferred.

**Compensation**

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
new_jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Seneca is seeking a **Business Operations Lead** to run strategic finance, accounting, contracts, insurance, compliance, purchasing, payroll and benefits, and the office. Right now those things are spread across an outside accounting firm, a payroll vendor, outside counsel, a fractional Head of Ops and the CEO. As we continue to scale, we are seeking someone who can up-level this organization both in terms of our daily operations and in key moments like M+A, equity and debt financings, key partnerships etc.

This role reports to the CEO with tight partnership. There will be opportunity to hire and/or bring in additional outside resources over the next twelve months.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Finance & Accounting**

* You run the finance function. Both FP&A and accounting.
* Partner with teams to ensure they pick the right strategies for both cost and revenue optimization as Seneca scales.
* Own the monthly close with our outside accounting firm.
* Get the accounting right for a hardware company moving into production: inventory, BOMs, capitalized R&D, fixed assets, and revenue recognition on multi-year contracts with agencies and utilities.
* Handle invoicing and collections, including milestone billing on government and utility contracts.
* Figure out the right policies for expense management and suggest our monthly budget – keeping us tracking to it.
* Keep the budget and board package current.

**Contracts, Compliance & Risk**

* Own contracts. Work with outside counsel on customer agreements, supplier terms, NDAs, and government contracting paperwork. Know what we have signed and what it commits us to.
* Own insurance, including aviation and product liability. For a drone company this is real work.
* Keep the compliance calendar: corporate filings, state registrations, export controls, and the requirements that come with selling to public agencies.

**Purchasing & Vendors**

* Run purchasing so engineers can get what they need fast and we still know where the money went: approvals, corporate cards, expense policy, vendor setup.
* Negotiate large vendor and supplier agreements.
* Partner with outside lawyers on where to draw the lines on NDAs, partnership agreements, and any other day to day legal questions.

**People Operations**

* Oversee payroll, benefits, and the HRIS through our vendors.
* Help us continue to drive exceptional recruitment.
* Own compensation and equity: bands, offers, grants, refreshes, and the promotion process, with the CEO.
* Make sure the basics are covered: I-9s, multi-state registrations, handbook, required trainings. Bring in outside HR counsel when a situation calls for it.
* Be someone employees can come to in confidence when something is wrong.

**Systems & the Office**

* Own the finance and ops systems (Ramp, Rippling, Carta, QuickBooks) and decide when to replace one.
* Run the Sausalito office: lease, facilities, IT and security basics, equipment. There are others in the loop here, but you have the opportunity to formalize facilities.

**What You Bring**
------------------

This is a high visibility / high upside role for a candidate who wants to be an early strategic partner to an experienced CEO in a high impact, high growth startup. You’ll often partner with the CEO, so a history of excellence is valued.

* Experience in strategic finance or private equity and/or investment banking
* You have run finance and operations at a venture-backed startup, ideally one that builds hardware, through a period of real growth.
* You understand accounting well enough to manage an outside firm and catch their mistakes: GAAP, revenue recognition, inventory, capitalized R&D.
* You are a generalist and you like operating. You fix things rather than write about them.
* You love to design scalable operational processes, including automating manual workflows, identifying future bottlenecks, and evaluating tools, partners, and vendors for long-term scalability
* You handle confidential information with care.
* You write and speak plainly, and you can explain business concepts to anyone.
* You want to work in person in Sausalito.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive Salary** — Reflective of your skills and experience
* **Equity Compensation** — Be an owner in the company's future
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** — Medical, dental, and vision plans
* **Health Savings Account (HSA)** — Optional pre-tax savings for medical expenses
* **Unlimited PTO** — Flexible time off to recharge, plus paid company holidays

**About Us**  
Seneca is building cutting-edge drone and sensor technology for wildfire suppression, aiming to eliminate wildfire risk across 500 million acres of high-risk U.S. + allied territory. Backed by top-tier investors, including Convective Capital, Caffeinated Capital, First Round Capital, Slow Ventures, Nextview Ventures, Transition Capital, Bullpen Capital, Stepstone Group, Roar Capital, Offline Ventures, and leaders from Palantir, Google, Meta, and many others. Founded by Stu Landesberg (former Founder & CEO of Grove Collaborative — IPO in 2022 at $1.7B) and fire industry experts, Seneca is a mission-driven company dedicated to climate resilience and fire prevention.

**Don’t meet every single requirement?** If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply — you may still be the right fit for our team.

Compensation Range: $125K - $200K

new_jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.  
  
We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.  
  
We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

**Location:** Remote (U.S.), with regular travel for in-person events
  
**Role type:** Full-time
  
**Reports to:** Kelly Mosher, Program Lead, Claude Corps  
**Compensation:** $130,000 to $155,000

**About Claude Corps**

In June 2026, Anthropic and CodePath launched Claude Corps, a $150M national fellowship. It places 1,000 paid, AI-skilled fellows in 12-month roles at mission-driven organizations across the country. Anthropic funds the program and sets strategy. CodePath employs the fellows and leads their training and programming.

The program is growing fast. Cohort 1 started in October 2026 with 100 fellows. Cohort 2 starts in March 2027 with 300. Cohort 3 starts in late summer 2027 with 600. Many fellows relocate to a new city for the year, so their experience, from offer letter to last day, decides whether the program works.

**About the role**

You'll be the Program Lead's right hand: a senior program manager who can take a whole area of Claude Corps, set the plan, and run it without being managed day to day. That frees Kelly to focus on program operations and strategy across the fellowship.

Your first area is the **fellow experience**, which today has no single end-to-end owner. You'll own how we communicate with, connect, and gather fellows, from offer through their last day. As the program scales, your scope will shift to wherever the biggest gap is. That could mean host organization experience or another part of the program, and future hires (for example, a community manager) may report to you.

This is a generalist role by design. We're hiring for strong program management judgment, not a single specialty.

**What success looks like**

**First 30 days: learn it and take the wheel**

* Get to know Cohort 1 (100 fellows live now), the mentor team, and our Anthropic partners
* Map the fellow journey from offer to day one, and name the three biggest gaps
* Take over day-to-day fellow communications (program inbox, fellow Slack, regular updates) from your manager
* Lock the Cohort 2 onboarding plan for 300 fellows: timeline, host matching updates, and relocation guidance

**Days 31 to 60: deliver Cohort 2 Basecamp**

* Run the week-long Cohort 2 Basecamp kickoff (starting Feb 22) with our event agency and curriculum team. You'll own the run of show, attendee experience, and on-site problem solving
* Get every Cohort 2 fellow from signed offer to day one with clear, consistent communication

**Days 61 to 90: build for scale**

* Launch a fellow support model that a small team can run for 1,000 fellows: self-serve resources, AI-assisted answers, and clear escalation to mentors, HR, and program leads
* Stand up community rituals and peer structures that don't depend on you to run
* Report engagement, satisfaction, and retention to CodePath and Anthropic leadership

**6 to 12 months**

* Cohort 3 (600 fellows) onboards on playbooks you wrote, with fewer people and fewer hours than Cohort 2
* You've documented what works so another team could pick it up and run it
* You've taken on a second program area where we need it most

**What you'll do**

* **Own the plan.** Set direction for your program area, make clear trade-offs, and tie the work to outcomes like fellow retention and engagement
* **Run the details.** Keep many workstreams moving at once and close loops without reminders
* **Communicate well.** Set honest expectations with fellows, keep the Claude Corps voice consistent, and keep host organizations informed in coordination with Anthropic's host team
* **Build systems, not heroics.** Use AI, including Claude, every day, and choose tools that let a small team serve thousands of people
* **Partner widely.** Work closely with the mentor team, curriculum, HR, outside vendors, and Anthropic partners

**What we're looking for**

**Required**

* 7+ years in program management, including owning a cohort-based program, fellowship, or member community end to end
* You've set direction for a program area yourself, not only carried out someone else's plan
* You can show how you run a heavy, changing workload: your system, what slipped once, and what you changed afterward
* You've moved work from manual to systematic, and you use AI tools hands-on in your daily work
* You write clearly and warmly and adjust your tone for fellows, executives, and partners
* You can travel to multi-day events several times a year, including February and late summer 2027

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in two or more of: participant communications, community building, or large in-person events with an outside agency
* Fellowships, service programs like AmeriCorps, or early-career talent programs
* Supporting participants through a relocation or major life transition
* Experience at a nonprofit, in education, or at a fast-growing startup

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**D5** is an AI-native design visualization ecosystem that unifies real-time rendering, team collaboration, and AEC-ready assets in one integrated workflow. The platform supports creative professionals from AI-driven ideation to precise visual control, helping them maintain an uninterrupted creative process. D5 focuses on delivering powerful, intuitive tools that streamline design visualization and improve efficiency for architecture, engineering, and construction teams. As a growing technology company, D5 values innovation, user-centric product development, and close collaboration with its global customer base.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Customer Workflow Discovery & Architecture:** Lead workflow reviews for Enterprise and key Mid-Market accounts. Assess authoring tools, BIM standards, AI/visualization stack, project data, collaboration and review; identify breakpoints and define a target-state D5 workflow.
* **Implementation & Technical Adoption:** Create account-specific plans for deployment, integrations, workflow configuration, training, standards, governance and adoption. Remain involved beyond the initial sale.
* **AI Workflow Evaluation & Enablement:** Evaluate how current generative AI, AI-assisted visualization, multimodal tools and emerging AI agents fit AEC delivery. Guide practical use cases, human review, repeatable templates and sensible model/tool selection.
* **Strategic Technical Account Coverage:** Maintain proactive relationships with practitioners, BIM/design technology leaders, visualization teams, IT and operations; anticipate issues before escalation.
* **Complex Pre-Sales & Validation Support:** Support high-value opportunities requiring custom demonstrations, POC planning, integration validation or executive-level technical conversations.
* **Training, Workshops & Enablement:** Plan and deliver customer trainings, webinars and workshops. Develop reusable playbooks, reference workflows and best practices for broader NA technical enablement.
* **Internal Technical Bridge:** Connect Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product and Engineering; translate customer requirements and AI-tool changes into practical actions and product feedback.
* **Governance, Security & Enterprise Readiness:** Advise on managed deployment, access, data/IP handling, AI policy, model/vendor evaluation, token/usage economics, collaboration and controlled rollout.

**Required Qualifications**

* **5+ years of experience** in Architecture, Engineering or Construction (AEC), BIM, design technology, visualization, VDC, technical consulting or closely related work.
* Demonstrated experience **assessing and improving AEC workflows**, not simply demonstrating software features.
* Strong working knowledge of **Revit, Rhino, SketchUp, 3ds Max** and/or comparable authoring tools, with familiarity with major AEC visualization platforms.
* Practical experience with **current AI tools and trends**: generative image/video and AI-assisted visualization, multimodal assistants, prompt-to-workflow approaches, and the shift from isolated outputs toward connected, repeatable AI-enabled processes.
* Ability to evaluate emerging AI tools for real AEC use cases, including **output quality, design intent, interoperability, data privacy, governance and usage/token cost**.
* Experience with **BIM implementation**, standards, training, enterprise adoption, project delivery or software rollout.
* Credible communication with practitioners and executive/technology leaders; excellent discovery, solution design, facilitation and follow-through.
* Ability to collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product and Engineering and travel for strategic customer engagements as needed.

**Strong Fit IndicatorsPreferred Background**

* **Senior Solutions Consultant, Strategic BIM Consultant, BIM/VDC Manager, Design Technology Leader, Technical Account Manager** or equivalent customer-facing technical advisor.
* Experience in an **AEC consultancy, software vendor, reseller or large multi-office design firm**.
* Hands-on workflow assessment, implementation planning, training, standards development and strategic advisory.
* Familiarity with tools and ecosystems such as **ChatGPT, Claude, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Autodesk Forma** and emerging AEC-focused AI visualization solutions *(specific products are examples, not mandatory requirements)*.
* Awareness of emerging **agent-based workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), configurable AI skills, bring-your-own-model approaches and enterprise AI governance**.

Pay: $82,000.00 - $100,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics**
------------------------------------------------------

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

The **Strategic Account Manager** is responsible for driving regional growth and expanding adoption of BillionToOne's UNITY™ prenatal screening platform across an assigned Region. Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, this role focuses on developing and growing strategic customer relationships within assigned health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), large physician groups, and key provider accounts.

The Strategic Account Manager partners closely with internal sales, clinical, medical affairs, customer success, and market access teams to identify growth opportunities, execute account plans, and support successful implementation and ongoing utilization of UNITY™. This is a remote field-based position with approximately travel throughout the assigned region.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute regional account plans to increase adoption and utilization of UNITY™ across assigned regional health systems.
* Build and maintain strong, impactful relationships with physicians, practice administrators, health system stakeholders, and other key decision-makers within the assigned health systems to secure UNITY utilization.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships and secure new business within assigned regional accounts.
* Partner with Regional Sales Managers, Prenatal Account Executives, and cross-functional teams to support customer onboarding, and successful implementation across enablers such as EMR and phlebotomy.
* Conduct business reviews and maintain regular communication with customers to ensure satisfaction and identify opportunities for growth.
* Analyze account performance and territory data to prioritize opportunities and maximize regional sales results.
* Maintain an in-depth understanding of BillionToOne's products, competitive landscape, and market dynamics.
* Accurately maintain customer information, sales activities, and pipeline within CRM tools.
* Represent BillionToOne professionally at customer meetings, regional conferences, and industry events.
* Collaborate effectively with internal teams to resolve customer issues and deliver an outstanding customer experience.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Minimum of **5 years** of successful sales or account management experience within diagnostics, genomics, molecular diagnostics or women's health.
* Experience calling on hospitals, health systems, IDNs, or large physician practices within assigned region preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales goals.
* Strong problem-solving, relationship-building, communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills.
* Outstanding collaboration skills.
* Ability to analyze territory performance and prioritize opportunities to drive growth.
* Working knowledge of the diagnostic reimbursement and healthcare delivery environment is preferred.
* Excellent organizational, time management, and follow-up skills.
* Self-motivated, collaborative, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 50% throughout the assigned region.

**Nice-to-Haves:**

* Experience working in a high-growth startup environment.
* Experience in prenatal diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, women's health, or genomics.
* Clinical laboratory experience or familiarity with laboratory operations.
* Experience managing complex healthcare accounts and cross-functional customer relationships.

**Benefits And Perks:**

* Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients
* Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings
* The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients
* Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%
* Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)
* Supplemental fertility benefits coverage
* Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match
* Increase paid time off with increased tenure
* Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of a (1) base pay + uncapped commissions (2) generous equity options offering, on top of (3) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid parental leave, etc.).

For this position, we offer a total compensation rate of $264,880 per year, including a base salary rate of $208,592 per year.

*BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
