new_jobs.title: IT Support Supervisor
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

PCI Federal Services is seeking an **IT Support Supervisor** to lead day-to-day end-user technology support while remaining a hands-on technical resource. This position supervises IT support personnel, manages workload and escalations, monitors service performance, develops team capabilities, and drives continuous improvement of the employee technology experience.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with practical leadership skills and can effectively balance people, priorities, service quality, and complex technical issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise IT support personnel, including work assignments, coverage, coaching, development, and performance feedback.
* Own day-to-day performance of the IT support function, including ticket backlog, service levels, escalations, documentation quality, and user communication.
* Manage the support queue and ensure incidents and requests are appropriately prioritized, assigned, and resolved.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex technical issues and employee concerns.
* Provide advanced support for Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune, endpoints, authentication, and connectivity.
* Monitor ticket trends and support metrics and recommend improvements to processes, tools, training, and service delivery.
* Maintain and improve support procedures, escalation practices, knowledge articles, and service standards.
* Oversee support activities related to employee onboarding, offboarding, equipment deployment, and IT asset lifecycle management.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate support processes using Microsoft technologies, PowerShell, ITSM workflows, and other approved tools.
* Support Microsoft 365 and Copilot adoption by identifying recurring support and training needs.
* Coordinate end-user technology deployments and lead smaller IT projects.
* Work with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and vendor resources to resolve issues outside the support team's scope.
* Ensure support activities follow company security, access-control, and data-handling requirements.
* Assign and balance daily ticket workload.
* Ensure adequate phone, remote-support and onsite coverage.
* Monitor aging tickets, unassigned tickets and breached service targets.
* Conduct regular team meetings and one-on-one coaching.
* Coordinate schedules, coverage and after-hours support.
* Review ticket documentation and customer communication.
* Identify training and development needs.
* The supervisor owns operational reporting for:

* Ticket backlog and aging
* First response and resolution performance
* Tickets Reopened
* Repeat incidents
* Escalation volume and quality
* Customer communication
* Knowledge article creation and use
* Onboarding and offboarding completion
* Equipment deployment and recovery
* Security-procedure adherence
* Training needs
* Recurring problem categories

**Qualifications**

* **5+ years** of progressively responsible IT support, service desk, desktop support, or related experience.
* Experience supervising, leading, coaching, or coordinating technical support personnel.
* Strong knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity/access, and modern workplace technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical issues and serve as an escalation resource.
* Experience with IT service management systems and support processes.
* Strong leadership, customer service, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance people’s leadership with hands-on technical responsibilities.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Microsoft 365 administration/support.
* Experience with SysAid, ServiceNow, or another ITSM platform.
* Experience with PowerShell, automation, or workflow improvement.
* Experience using service metrics and trends to improve support operations.
* ITIL, Microsoft, CompTIA, or comparable certification.
* Experience supporting geographically distributed and remote employees.
* Experience in a government contracting, regulated, or security-conscious environment.

**Education**

Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred. Relevant professional experience, military technical training, certifications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Work Requirements**

This position may be based in Huntsville, Atmore, the Washington, DC metropolitan area, or remote. Periodic travel to PCI Federal locations may be required.

new_jobs.title: Training Manager, Field Access & Reimbursement
new_jobs.description:
**Description**

The Field Access and Reimbursement Training Manager Consultant will develop and support delivery of training programs that support Field Access Manager (FAM) teams and related commercial functions. This individual will partner closely with client stakeholders to identify practical, compliant, and field-focused training needs that enhance access and reimbursement capabilities, product knowledge, and field execution.

The ideal candidate brings experience in pharmaceutical field access, reimbursement, patient support services, training facilitation, and adult learning principles, along with the ability to work across multiple therapeutic areas. Initial focus will support Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) and Eosinophilic Esophagitis (EoE).

**Key Responsibilities**

Facilitation & Training Delivery

* Develop and support training strategies aligned to client business objectives, field access priorities, and therapeutic area needs.
* Partner with client stakeholders to review and enhance training needs for Field Access Manager teams and related commercial or medical support functions.
* Ensure training programs are practical, field-relevant, compliant, and aligned to access and reimbursement priorities.
* Evaluate current workshops and training materials and recommend improvements based on business needs and learner feedback.
* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of National Sales Meetings (NSMs), Plan of Action (POA) Meetings, and District Meetings, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver training content and ensure successful meeting outcomes.
* Facilitate engaging virtual, live, and hybrid training programs.
* Manage training deliverables across onboarding, backfill training, and ongoing field education initiatives.
* Adapt facilitation techniques to diverse learner groups and varying levels of experience.
* Foster an interactive learning environment that promotes participation, collaboration, and application of key concepts.
* Serve as a credible training partner across clinical, medical, access, reimbursement, and field-based topics.

Client Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  

* Build strong partnerships with client stakeholders across Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Learning & Development functions.
* Partner with subject matter experts to ensure content accuracy and relevance.
* Provide proactive communication regarding project status, priorities, risks, and deliverables.
* Align training initiatives with strategic business objectives and organizational goals.

Learning Measurement & Continuous Improvement

* Assess training effectiveness through learner feedback, knowledge assessments, stakeholder input, and performance indicators.
* Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities.
* Monitor business needs and evolving market dynamics to ensure training remains relevant and effective.
* Recommend enhancements to learning materials, workshops, and delivery methods.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, medical education, training, or related industry environments.
* Experience supporting Field Access Manager, Market Access, Reimbursement, Patient Services, or related field-based functions.
* Strong facilitation experience delivering virtual and instructor-led training programs.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing training curricula and learning solutions.
* General clinical and healthcare knowledge with the ability to support multiple therapeutic areas.
* Strong project management, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote, client-facing environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to Boston and other meeting locations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) and/or Eosinophilic Esophagitis (EoE).
* Experience with specialty pharmacy, market access, reimbursement, patient support, or field reimbursement programs.
* Instructional design and curriculum development expertise.
* Experience supporting pharmaceutical product launches.
* Prior experience working with field-based commercial, access, reimbursement, or patient services teams.

The anticipated hourly rate for this position is $60.00/hr to $65.00/hr but may vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** We partner with industry experts to solve and execute against today’s toughest commercialization challenges facing the world’s leading healthcare companies. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities on our Commercial Operations and Leadership teams. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.
